text_iast: viyogād yena viyujyate tadviyogapratisaṃvedī bhṛśaṃ smarati
kanyāṃ gṛhītvā varteta preṣyavad yatra nāyakaḥ
yadi yāvad avicchinnaṃ nānekaṃ cakṣuṣo viṣayastadekaṃ dravyaṃ kalpyate pṛthivyāṃ krameṇetirna syādgamanamityarthaḥ
sarvaguṇasampannaścāyaṃ rājā śrūyate na cāsya kaścid guṇo dṛśyate yaḥ paurajānapadān daṇḍakarābhyāṃ pīḍayati iti
yena hi karmaṇā nārakāṇāṃ tatra tādṛśo bhūtānāṃ saṃbhavaḥ kalpyate pariṇāmaśca tasya karmaṇo vāsanā teṣāṃ vijñānasaṃtānasaṃniviṣṭā nānyatra
ahnaścāṣṭame bhāge paṇyādhyakṣasyārpayeyuḥ idaṃ vikrītam idaṃ śeṣam iti
dūrācchabdaṃ śṛṇoti sati ca prāptaviṣayatve divyaṃ cakṣuḥśrotramiha manuṣyeṣu dhyāyināṃ nopajāyeta ghrāṇādivat
lakṣaṇaṃ paśvavayavasthaṃ gotrasya smṛtihetur vidānām idaṃ gargāṇām idam iti
tatastadanumatena prātiveśyābhavane niśi nāyakam ānāyya śrotriyāgārād agnim iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa
mṛṣeme vadanti satyam u te vadantīti
saṃsthādhyakṣaḥ paṇyasaṃsthāyāṃ purāṇabhāṇḍānāṃ svakaraṇaviśuddhānām ādhānaṃ vikrayaṃ vā sthāpayet
tasmād apīti siddhe cakāreṇa śeṣavata iti samuccitam
tasyāsiddhau rūpādīnāṃ cakṣurādiviṣayatvam asiddhamiti siddhaṃ vijñaptimātraṃ bhavatīti
balaṃ ca hīyate yasya rājayakṣmā hinasti tam
annaṃ ca cyavate bhuktaṃ sthitaṃ cāpi na jīryati
bhūtānām ādibhūtas tamobahulas tenoktaḥ sa tāmasa iti
paraviṣaye tu paṇyapratipaṇyayor arghaṃ mūlyaṃ cāgamayya śulkavartanyātivāhikagulmataradeyabhaktabhāgavyayaśuddham udayaṃ paśyet
tatrānupalabdhir yathā na pradeśaviśeṣe kvacid ghaṭaḥ upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasya anupalabdher iti
anekarūpā jāyante vraṇo dṛṣṭau ca dṛṣṭihā

evaṃ pṛthivyādayastanmātrāṇi viśantaḥ svāpekṣayā tanmātrāṇy avyaktayanty evaṃ tanmātrāṇyahaṃkāraṃ viśantyahaṃkāram avyaktayantyevam ahaṃkāro mahāntam āviśan mahāntam avyaktayati mahān svaṃ kāraṇaṃ viśan prakṛtim avyaktayati
padebhya eva padārthapratyayaḥ padārthebhyo vākyārtha iti
evaṃ ca jāraṇabījavaśena jāraṇāyāṃ yadbījaṃ kiyadguṇajāritamiti bhāvaḥ tadvaśena koṭivedhī ca syāt
lihyādvā madhutailābhyāṃ bhuktvā khādet kaṭūni vā
laukikaparīkṣakāṇāṃ yasmin arthe buddhisāmyaṃ so dṛṣṭāntaḥ
kṣaumābaddhaṃ pathyamāścyotane vā sarpirghṛṣṭaṃ yaṣṭikāhvaṃ sarodhram
kṛtārthaṃ prati naṣṭam apy anaṣṭaṃ tadanyasādhāraṇatvāt
tat katham ucyate tadviparītaḥ pumān iti
mayyāveśya mano ye māṃ nityayuktā upāsate
sarveṣām eva rogāṇāṃ nidānaṃ kupitā malāḥ
yasmāduktaṃ na caitāstanavaḥ kevalaṃ mama iti
āsāṃ tuṣṭīnāṃ viparītā aśaktibhedād buddhivadhā bhavanti
dvābhyāṃ tribhiś caturbhis tair yamakas trivṛto mahān
prastāri prathitamihārma śuklabhāge vistīrṇaṃ tanu rudhiraprabhaṃ sanīlam
kanyām anyāṃ darśayitvānyāṃ prayacchataḥ śatyo daṇḍastulyāyām hīnāyāṃ dviguṇaḥ
tena prakṛtiṃ parām apekṣamāṇaṃ kāryopajanane paratantraṃ vyaktam
devīgṛhe līno hi bhrātā bhadrasenaṃ jaghāna mātuḥ śayyāntargataśca putraḥ kārūṣam

file: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti-0007-Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 3-2364.conllu
chapter: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 3

text_iast: prītir ātmā bhāvo yeṣāṃ te prītyātmānaḥ
tasmāt sukhaduḥkhamohair iva virodhibhir avirodhibhiḥ sukhaprakāśalāghavair na nimittabhedā unnīyanta evaṃ duḥkhopastambhapravartakatvair evaṃ mohagurutvāvaraṇair iti siddhaṃ traiguṇyam iti
sa saṃskāraḥ svavyañjakāñjanas tadākārām eva grāhyagrahaṇobhayātmikāṃ smṛtiṃ janayati
dvāvapyetau yathā pretau tathā jñeyau vijānatā
kṣaumagarbhāṃ kṛtāṃ vartiṃ dhūmaṃ ghrāṇāsyataḥ pibet
sā cittibhir ni hi cakāra martyaṃ vidyudbhavantī prati vavrim auhata
vivikte bhāvaṃ darśayati niṣkāraṇaṃ cāgūḍham anyatra pracchannapradeśāt
ayaṃ sa śabdāyate yena gaur abhipravṛttā mimāti
pracchanneṣu pradeśeṣu tāsām anusmaraṇārthaṃ rāgavardhanācca viśeṣān darśayet
asmatpakṣe punaḥ sūrpaṃ stūyate tena hy annaṃ kriyata iti vṛttāntānvākhyānaṃ na ca vṛttāntajñāpanāya kiṃ tarhi prarocanāyaiva
grāmāraṇyānām adhvani niveśān yavasendhanodakavaśena parisaṃkhyāya sthānāsanagamanakālaṃ ca yātrāṃ yāyāt
triścatur vā mṛdau tatra dravyāṇyaguru guggulu
taddhi nirdiśyate yasmāt sūrpeṇānnaṃ kriyate tasmāt sūrpeṇa juhotīti
tad idaṃ dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyasamatvam abhidhīyata iti
na kenacit kāryate karaṇaṃ puruṣārtha evaikaḥ kārayatīti vākyārthaḥ
kathaṃ jñānena bahirmukhenāvabhāsena sarvaṃ gocaraṃ nīlasukhādirūpaṃ viṣayam ālokya
yadā tu mūrchantyathavāpi jantavaḥ sṛjantyapatyānyathavāpi makṣikāḥ
tadabhiprasannair amānuṣaistadvāsinaḥ sattvā utsāditā na tvṛṣīṇāṃ manaḥpradoṣānmṛtā ityevaṃ sati kathaṃ tena karmaṇā manodaṇḍaḥ kāyavāgdaṇḍābhyāṃ mahāvadyatamaḥ siddho bhavati
jīvantīśvetāmuṣkakapuṣpavandākābhir akṣīve jātasyāśvatthasya pratānena guptaṃ sarpā viṣāṇi vā na prabhavanti
guptaputradārān ākarakarmānteṣu vā vāsayet pareṣām āspadabhayāt
tad anāgatāvekṣaṇena tantrayuktyā prītyādīnāṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ veditavyam
yad vā guruḥ parā śaktir īśvarānugrahātmikā
gundrāṃ śāliṃ śaivalaṃ śailabhedaṃ dārvīmelāmutpalaṃ rodhramabhram
teṣāṃ kārtāntikanaimittikamauhūrtikavyañjanāḥ parasparābhisambandham amitrāṭavikasambandhaṃ vā vidyuḥ
rāgavaśāt prahaṇanābhyāse vāraṇamokṣaṇālam arthānāṃ śabdānām ambārthānāṃ ca satāntaśvasitaruditastanitamiśrīkṛtaprayogā virutānāṃ ca

file: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti-0004-Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Prathama adhyāyaḥ, 5.1-2339.conllu
chapter: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Prathama adhyāyaḥ, 5.1

text_iast: sārabhāṇḍam ityasārabhāṇḍaṃ tajjātam ityatajjātaṃ rādhāyuktam ityupadhiyuktaṃ samudgaparivartimaṃ vā vikrayādhānaṃ nayato hīnamūlyaṃ catuṣpañcāśatpaṇo daṇḍaḥ paṇamūlyaṃ dviguṇo dvipaṇamūlyaṃ dviśataḥ
prayatnagrahaṇaṃ kim icuyaśānāṃ tulyasthānānāṃ bhinnajātīyānāṃ mā bhūt
tena sarveṣāṃ samānadeśatvātsarvaḥ piṇḍaḥ paramāṇumātraḥ syātparasparavyatirekāditi na kaścitpiṇḍo dṛśyaḥ syāt
dāho dhūmāyanaṃ śophaḥ śyāvatā vartmano bahiḥ
svaviṣayānantaraviṣayasahakāriṇā indriyajñānena samanantarapratyayena janitaṃ tan manovijñānam
vyūḍhānāṃ hi vivāhānām anurāgaḥ phalaṃ yataḥ
tasya ceddantāḥ parikīrṇāḥ śvetā jātaśarkarāḥ syuḥ parāsuriti vidyāt

akṛtābhyāgamācca pravṛttir vāgbuddhiśarīrārambha iti caitanye bhūtendriyamanasāṃ parakṛtaṃ karma puruṣeṇopabhujyata iti syād acaitanye tu tatsādhanasya svakṛtakarmaphalopabhogaḥ puruṣasyetyupapadyata iti
kāraṇaṃ yallakṣaṇam tallakṣaṇam eva kāryam api
vṛtta caula karmā lipim saṃkhyānam ca upayuñjīta vṛtta upanayanaḥ trayīm ānvīkṣikīm ca śiṣṭebhyaḥ vārttām adhyakṣebhyaḥ daṇḍanītim vaktṛ prayoktṛbhyaḥ
tasmin kṛtasaṃyamasya yoginaḥ divyaṃ śrotraṃ pravartate yugapat sūkṣmavyavahitaviprakṛṣṭaśabdagrahaṇasamarthaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ
paścātsūtaṃ śuddhaṃ kṛtvā pāradaṃ nirnāgaṃ vidhāya tadanu nāgajāraṇānantaraṃ bījavaraṃ pūrvoktaṃ yojayet
eṣa sūkṣmo vidhiḥ proktaḥ siddhā eva sphuṭaṃ striyaḥ
uktam etad yathā kāryasyāvyaktāvasthā kāraṇam eveti
rāgāvasānakāle jaghanapārśvayostāḍanam ityatitvarayā ca ā parisamāpteḥ
kṛṣṇaṃ vā yadi vā śuklaṃ niśāṃ vrajati saptamīm
vaiśeṣikaṃ ca vidhimūrdhvamato vadāmi taṃ vai svarāturahitaṃ nikhilaṃ nibodha
sādhitaṃ tailam ājyaṃ vā nasyaṃ kṣavapuṭapraṇut
tasya cet pakṣmāṇi jaṭābaddhāni syuḥ parāsuriti vidyāt
ratiṃ na labhate yāti paralokaṃ samāntaram
tasmād bhūtāder ahaṃkārāt tanmātraḥ pañcako gaṇa utpadyate
tattvasya jñānaṃ niḥśreyasasyādhigama iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhau
ataḥ prayatnānantaryāt tena kriyata iti gamyate
sattvatamasī svayam akriyatayā svakārye pravṛttiṃ pratyavasīdantī rajasopaṣṭabhyete avasādāt pracyāvya svakārya utsāhaṃ prayatnaṃ kāryete
samīpe śayānāyāḥ supto nāma karam upari vinyaset
sa cet brūyāt dāyādyād avāptam amuṣmāllabdhaṃ krītaṃ kāritam ādhipracchannam ayam asya deśaḥ kālaścopasamprāpter ayam asyārghaḥ pramāṇaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ mūlyaṃ ca iti tasyāgamasamādhau mucyeta
nistārayitvā kāntārān naṣṭāṃ tyaktāṃ mṛteti vā
evaṃ ca yat pūrvam uktaṃ tasmācchabdārthacintāsu na sāvasthā na yā śivaḥ ityādi na tena saha parāmṛtarasāpāyas tasya yaḥ pratyayodbhavaḥ ityasya vaiṣamyaṃ kiṃcit
tathā hi buddhyādaya upāttam upāttaṃ dehaṃ tyajanti dehāntaraṃ copādadata iti teṣāṃ parispandaḥ
taccāsya trikālaviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ pratyātmavedanīyaṃ jñāsyāmi jānāmi ajñāsiṣam iti vartate tad yasyāyaṃ svo dharmas tasya smaraṇaṃ na buddhiprabandhamātrasya nirātmakasyeti
yataḥ kāraṇāt gaganamabhraṃ sarvāṅgaṃ na grasate rasa iti śeṣaḥ

file: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti-0015-Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 11-2377.conllu
chapter: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 11

text_iast: karmanimitte tu sukhaduḥkhayoge karmaṇāṃ tīvramandatopapatteḥ karmasañcayānāṃ cotkarṣāpakarṣabhāvāt nānāvidhaikavidhabhāvāc ca karmaṇāṃ sukhaduḥkhabhedopapattiḥ
yasmin sati yadbhavati tattasyādhipateyamiti ta ete catvāraḥ pratyayāḥ
nāstyatra gaṇanā kācin na ca śāstraparigrahaḥ
tattārapatraṃ punaḥ garbhe rasodare dravati jalatvamāpnoti
bahuvrīhau iti kiṃ dvandve vibhāṣā mā bhūt
asaṃdigdhaviparītānadhigataviṣayā cittavṛttiḥ bodhaḥ pauruṣeyaḥ phalaṃ pramā tatsādhanaṃ pramāṇam iti saṃśayaviparyayasmṛtisādhanānāṃ pramāṇeṣvaprasaṅgaḥ
iha kulālaḥ śakto mṛddaṇḍacakracīvararajjunīrādikaraṇopakaraṇaṃ vā śakyam eva ghaṭam mṛtpiṇḍād utpādayati
evam ahaṃkārādibhir api svakāryajanana iti sarvaṃ svakārye prakṛtyāpūram apekṣate
ubhayoḥ ṛvarṇasya ṝvarṇasya cāntaratamaḥ savarṇo dīrgho nāsti iti ṛkāra eva dīrgho bhavati
yadā punaḥ śarīrāhaṃkārabhāvaṃ parityajya svātantreṇa manaso vṛttiḥ sā akalpitā tasyāṃ saṃyamāt yoginaḥ sarve cittamalāḥ kṣīyante
tamasaś cāpi mithune te sattvarajasī ubhe
ta etāvanto vidyamānārthāḥ yeṣām aviparītajñānārtham ihopadeśaḥ
samānānekadharmopapatteḥ vipratipatteḥ upalabdhyanupalabdhyavyavasthātaśca viśeṣāpekṣo vimarśaḥ saṃśayaḥ
antaḥsthā dviprabhedāḥ rephavarjitā yavalāḥ sānunāsikā niranunāsikāś ca
ahitaṃ trividho yogas trayāṇāṃ prāg udāhṛtaḥ
sukham anupahatam ekacāritāyāṃ nāyikānurāgaṃ ca varṇayet
svabhūmau ca vaset sarvaḥ parabhūmau na saṃcaret
tasmād bāhyam adhiṣṭhānaṃ kṛtvā kārye caturvidhe
yatraiva ca vāsanā tatraiva tasyāḥ phalaṃ tādṛśo vijñānapariṇāmaḥ kiṃ neṣyate
dṛṣṭau ca kramaśo vyādhau śataṃ trīṇi ca pañca ca
mohaḥ svākhyātir ajñānaṃ tena yaḥ pratisaṃhataḥ
yuñjyāt sarpirdhūmadarśī narastu śeṣaṃ kuryādraktapitte vidhānam
anityāyāṃ ca buddhāv utpannāpavargitvāt kālāntarāvasthānācca anityānāṃ saṃśayaḥ kim utpannāpavargiṇī buddhiḥ śabdavat āhosvit kālāntarāvasthāyinī kumbhavad iti
atra ca sukhaduḥkhamohāḥ parasparaṃ virodhinaḥ svānurūpāṇi sukhaduḥkhamohātmakānyeva nimittāni kalpayanti
yato buddhisthaṃ sarvaṃ viṣayasukhādikaṃ puruṣa upalabhyate
śuṣkālpā dūṣikā śītam acchaṃ cāśru calā rujaḥ
maraṇaṃ jīvitaṃ caiva sa bhiṣak jñātumarhati
yat tv abhiyuktāḥ śabdārtheṣu śiṣṭā iti
kena prakāreṇa kiṃdharmakāt kāraṇād vyaktaṃ śarīrādyutpadyata iti vyaktād bhūtasamākhyātāt pṛthivyāditaḥ paramasūkṣmān nityād vyaktaṃ śarīrendriyaviṣayopakaraṇādhāraṃ prajñātaṃ dravyam utpadyate
skandhau śiraḥ stanāntaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ jaghanaṃ pārśva iti sthānāni
icchādveṣābhyāṃ yam icchati yaṃ ca dveṣṭi taṃ smarati
atha mataṃ yena yenānnaṃ kriyate praṇāḍyā sūrpād anyenāpi tena tenāpi homaḥ kriyata iti
saṃkalpakaṃ mana iti lakṣaṇam uktaṃ tena saṃkalpa eva manaso vṛttiḥ
api ca bahubhir uccārayadbhir mahān śabdaḥ śrūyate
na ciraṃ tasya caivānte prakṛter eva yojanam
sparśaprādhānyenaivāturasyāyuṣaḥ pramāṇāvaśeṣaṃ jijñāsuḥ prakṛtisthena pāṇinā śarīramasya kevalaṃ spṛśet parimarśayed vānyena
evaṃ copakramopasaṃhārayor mahārthasaṃpuṭīkāraṃ darśayan tatsāratayā samastaśāṃkaropaniṣanmūrdhanyatām asyāviṣkaroti śāstrasya śrīmān vasuguptācāryaḥ iti śivam
prāṇādyā vāyavaḥ pañca prāṇāpānasamānodānavyānā iti pañca vāyavaḥ sarvendriyāṇāṃ sāmānyā vṛttiḥ
parimṛśatā tu khalvāturaśarīramime bhāvāstatra tatrāvaboddhavyā bhavanti
rodhraṃ drākṣāṃ śarkarāmutpalaṃ ca nāryāḥ kṣīre yaṣṭikāhvaṃ vacāṃ ca
ucchedāya ca jātānāṃ pibed dhūmaṃ sadātmavān
sattvapuruṣayor atyantāsaṃkīrṇayoḥ pratyayāviśeṣaḥ bhogaḥ parārthatvāt svārthasaṃyamāt puruṣajñānam
tatra prathamaṃ siddhacitteṣu kaivalyabhāgīyaṃ cittaṃ nirdhārayitukāmaḥ pañcatayīṃ siddhim āha janmauṣadhimantratapaḥsamādhijāḥ siddhayaḥ
ekam eva darśanaṃ khyātir eva darśanam iti
tadabhivyaktau kevalaḥ śuddho muktaḥ svarūpapratiṣṭhaḥ puruṣa iti
āsanne ca vivāhe mātaram asyāstad abhimatadoṣair anuśayaṃ grāhayet
svaviṣayasaṃprayogābhāve cittasvarūpānukāra iveti cittanirodhe cittavan niruddhānīndriyāṇi netarendriyajayavad upāyāntaram apekṣante
guṇānāṃ kartṛtvābhimānaśithilībhāvasvarūpāt tanmāhātmyāt tatraiva sthitasya yoginaḥ sarvabhāvādhiṣṭhātṛtvaṃ sarvajñātṛtvaṃ vā samādhir bhavati
satyapi anekadravyavattve mahattve ca rūpākhyasya saṃskārasyābhāvād vāyāvanupalabdhiḥ

tatra dharmopadhāśuddhān dharmasthīyakaṇṭakaśodhaneṣu karmasu sthāpayet arthopadhāśuddhān samāhartṛsaṃnidhātṛnicayakarmasu kāmopadhāśuddhān bāhyābhyantaravihārarakṣāsu bhayopadhāśuddhān āsannakāryeṣu rājñaḥ
puruṣārthaḥ kartavya ityevam arthaṃ guṇānāṃ pravṛttiḥ
yathaiva te na guror bhojanīyās tathaiva tān na bhunakti śrutaṃ tat
bhrātaram asyā vā samānavayasaṃ veśyāsu parastrīṣu vā prasaktam asukareṇa sāhāyadānena priyopagrahaiśca sudīrghakālam anurañjayet
tam imam arthaṃ prāmāṇikaṃ kartum abhimatāḥ pramāṇabhedā darśanīyāḥ
yasya śyāve paridhvaste harite cāpi darśane
yojanam adhamā adhyardhaṃ madhyamā dviyojanam uttamā sambhāvyā vā gatiḥ
etayaiva savicārā nirvicārā ca sūkṣmaviṣayā vyākhyātā
kāraṇāt saṃsparśanaṃ sahate nāvabudhyate nāma dvidhābhūtamānasā sātatyena kṣāntyā vā sādhyā
ātmā brahma ca vāk caiva na śakyaṃ bhedadarśanam
caturthas tu śvāsapraśvāsayor viṣayāvadhāraṇāt krameṇa bhūmijayād ubhayākṣepapūrvako gatyabhāvaścaturthaḥ prāṇāyāma ity ayaṃ viśeṣaḥ
kāraṇaguṇapūrvaḥ kārye guṇo dṛṣṭaḥ kāryāntarāprādurbhāvācca śabdaḥ sparśavatāmaguṇaḥ
adhyāpitā ye guruṃ nādriyante viprā vācā manasā karmaṇā vā
prakṛtestu na kvacinniveśa iti sā sarvakāryāṇām avyaktam eva
prāpnotyato vā vibhraṃśaṃ samāntaṃ tasya jīvitam
deśakālāntaritānāṃ tu paṇyānāṃ prakṣepaṃ paṇyaniṣpattiṃ śulkaṃ vṛddhim avakrayam
sāmānyatodṛṣṭād atīndriyāṇām pradhānapuruṣādīnām pratītiściticchāyāpattir buddher adhyavasāya ityarthaḥ
tatra vāg vadati hastau nānāvyāpāraṃ kurutaḥ pādau gamanāgamanaṃ pāyur utsargaṃ karotyupastha ānandaṃ prajotpattyā
pitte ṣaṭ svasthavṛtte ca balāse pañca dhārayet
itthaṃ pratidinaṃ vāyau pitte tvekāntaraṃ kaphe
viriktaḥ punar ādhmāti yathā pretastathaiva saḥ
ahetumannityatvādi pradhānasādharmyam asti puruṣasya evam anekatvam vyaktasādharmyam
kālena mokṣo bhaviṣyatīti kiṃ tattvābhyāsenetyeṣa kālākhyā tuṣṭiḥ
mā bhūnnyūnam adhikaṃ ca kasmānna bhavati
gairikaṃ saindhavaṃ kṛṣṇāṃ nāgaraṃ ca yathottaram
chidrair aṇumukhair vastu citaṃ yasya samantataḥ
aha iti ca ha iti ca vinigrahārthīyā
keśākeśikaṃ saṃgrahaṇam upaliṅganād vā śarīropabhogānām tajjātebhyaḥ strīvacanād vā
kathaṃ vā tadekaṃ yatprāptaṃ ca tābhyāṃ na ca prāptamantarāle tacchūnyagrahaṇāt
sad anityaṃ dravyavat kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣavad iti dravyaguṇakarmaṇām aviśeṣaḥ
nāgaṃ sīsakaṃ truṭitaṃ buddhvā punarapi nāgaṃ dahyāt pūrvoktavidhānena pārade iti śeṣaḥ
na śṛṇoti gatāsuṃ taṃ buddhimān parivarjayet
catuṣpadadvipadānām api hi rūpaliṅgasāmānyaṃ bhavati kim aṅga punar ekayonidravyakartṛprasūtānāṃ kupyābharaṇabhāṇḍānām iti
kiṃ sāmānyaṃ rūpādiguṇayogaḥ rūpādiguṇayuktebhyaḥ pṛthivyādibhyo nityebhyo rūpādiguṇayuktaṃ śarīrādyutpadyate
vinaṣṭaḥ śabdaḥ punar asya kriyamāṇasyārthenākṛtakaḥ saṃbandho nopapadyate
grāhyoparaktaḥ pratyayo grāhyagrahaṇobhayākāranirbhāsas tajjātīyakaṃ saṃskāram ārabhate
evaṃ tamaḥ sattvarajasī abhibhūya mūḍhām iti
nijāśuddhiśabdenamalaṃ nāma dravyaṃ pṛthagbhūtam astīti ye pratipannāste dūṣyatvena kaṭākṣitāḥ
siddhaṃ vātaharaiḥ kṣīraṃ prathamena gaṇena vā
tathā hi sattvaṃ pravṛttiniyamāvāśritya rajastamasoḥ prakāśenopakaroti
anenaiva ca dehena maheśvaratvam avāpnotyeveti yāvat
doṣān parasya na dhyāyet tasya pāpaṃ sadā muniḥ
yam eva vidyāḥ śucim apramattaṃ medhāvinaṃ brahmacaryopapannam
ārṣaṃ tu vijñānaṃ yogināṃ na lokapratipādanāyālam iti sad api nābhihitam anadhikārāt
mayā purastāt prasamīkṣya yojayediha iva tāvat prayato bhiṣagvaraḥ
hāsasya dantakāṣṭhasya dhūmam ante piben mṛdum
jñātisaṅghaṃ sa saṃkleśya tena rogeṇa hanyate
tatra māṃsārbudaḥ yacca māṃsapākaśca yaḥ smṛtaḥ
dravyāśrayy aguṇavān saṃyogavibhāgeṣv akāraṇam anapekṣa iti guṇalakṣaṇam
na sidhyanti narā daṣṭāḥ pāṣaṇḍāyataneṣu ca
vṛkṣo vraścanād vṛtvā kṣāṃ tiṣṭhatīti vā
anabhiyogaś ca śabdārtheṣv aśiṣṭānām abhiyogaś cetareṣām
evam pañcabhir hetubhiḥ pradhāne mahadādi liṅgam asti
snigdho madhyaḥ sa tīkṣṇaśca vāte vātakaphe kaphe
vaidūryaṃ yat sphāṭikaṃ vaidrumaṃ ca mauktaṃ śāṅkhaṃ rājataṃ śātakumbham
ya ātṛṇatty avitathena karṇāv aduḥkham kurvann amṛtaṃ samprayacchan
grāmāntaram udyānaṃ vā gacchantīṃ viditvā susaṃbhṛtasahāyo nāyakastadā rakṣiṇo vitrāsya hatvā vā kanyām apaharet
tataḥ śrotriyāgārād agnim iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa
ikaḥ iti kim āt sandhyakṣaravyañjanānāṃ mā bhūt
jāraṃ cora ityabhiharataḥ pañcaśato daṇḍo hiraṇyena muñcatastadaṣṭaguṇaḥ
dīrghakālāsevito nirantarāsevitaḥ satkārāsevitaḥ tapasā brahmacaryeṇa vidyayā śraddhayā ca sampāditaḥ satkāravān dṛḍhabhūmir bhavati vyutthānasaṃskāreṇa drāg ity evānabhibhūtaviṣaya ity arthaḥ
yathā kaścid avijñāyaiva tattvānyupādānagrahaṇaṃ karoti tridaṇḍakamaṇḍaluvividikābhyo mokṣa iti tasyāpi nāsti mokṣa iti
dvandvaśca jighatsāpipāse śītoṣṇe sthānāsane kāṣṭhamaunākāramaune ca
bahūn api viṣahate abhiyogān na ca cireṇāpi prayacchatyātmānaṃ sā śuṣkapratigrāhiṇī paricayavighaṭanasādhyā
na saṃśayaḥ ityanena idaṃ dhvanayati dīkṣādinā gurupratyayato muktiḥ īdṛśāt tu jñānāt samācārādvā svapratyayata eveti
varṇānyatā vā rājyo vā yasya gātre bhavanti hi

file: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti-0007-Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 3-2364.conllu
chapter: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 3

text_iast: nimittam aprayojakaṃ prakṛtīnāṃ varaṇabhedas tu tataḥ kṣetrikavat
kṣavathau puṭakākhye ca tīkṣṇaiḥ pradhamanaṃ hitam
sā ca dvayī bhāvitasmartavyā ca abhāvitasmartavyā ca
tatra yadāsya bhagavati deve nityatā katham
samanorathāyāś cāsyā apāyaṃ sādhvasaṃ vrīḍāṃ ca hetubhir avacchindyāt
krimigranthirvartmanaḥ pakṣmaṇaś ca kaṇḍūṃ kuryuḥ krimayaḥ sandhijātāḥ
dhruvam ākāśagaṅgāṃ vā taṃ vadanti gatāyuṣam
kaṭutīkṣṇair ghṛtair nasyaiḥ kavaḍaiḥ sarvajaṃ jayet
atha ya evaikasya paramāṇordeśaḥ sa eva ṣaṇṇām
yanmāṃsaṃ pracayam upaiti śuklabhāge padmābhaṃ tadupadiśanti lohitārma
utkṣepaṇam avakṣepaṇam ākuñcanaṃ prasāraṇaṃ gamanam iti karmāṇi
ekadravyam aguṇaṃ saṃyogavibhāgeṣv anapekṣaṃ kāraṇam iti karmalakṣaṇam
bhinnaṃ purīṣaṃ tṛṣṇā ca sadyaḥ prāṇāñjahāti saḥ
ānantyāya iti caturthī tasmāt tapa etat na tu vidyā kāryā
indraṃ na tvā śavasā devatā vāyuṃ pṛṇanti

file: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti-0011-Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 7-2368.conllu
chapter: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 7

text_iast: viṣāṇī tasmādaśvo viṣāṇī tasmād gauriti ca
aśakto vā sainyeṣvāyojayet antareṣu vā nicinuyāt
tasmād vaikṛtād ahaṃkārād ekādaśaka indriyagaṇa utpadyate
tāsāṃ nāmāni śāstrāntare proktānyaṃbhaḥ salilam ogho vṛṣṭiḥ sutamaḥ pāraṃ sunetraṃ nārīkam anuttamāmbhasikam iti
laukikeṣu punar artheṣu pratyakṣeṇārtham upalabhya sanniyamaḥ sannibandhanaṃ śakyaṃ tatra saṃhartum evaṃjātīyakāni vākyāni nīlotpalavaneṣv adyeti
tṛṣṇodbhūtā kurute pañcavidhāṃ liṅgataḥ śṛṇu tām
na hyeṣu dhīrāḥ paśyanti siddhiṃ kāṃcidupakramāt
cakṣuḥsthānīyayā vidyayā kuśalavivekādikāryaṃ māhātmyātigatiprakāśapravṛttismṛtisāyujyasthityādiprakāśanaṃ tapaḥkāryamityarthaḥ evaṃ ca gupte brāhmaṇe tapa ānantyāya prakāśata ityarthaḥ
ṣakārāntā nakārāntā ca yā saṅkhyā sā ṣaṭsañjñā bhavati
dṛṣṭānte ca sādhyasādhanabhāvena prajñātasya dharmasya tasya cobhayathā bhāvānnāviśeṣaḥ
pāke dīptau ca pittaghnaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ nasyādi saṃsrutau
śuklasthāḥ sitapiḍakāḥ sirāvṛtā yāstā vidyādasitasamīpajāḥ sirājāḥ
tathā rudraḥ samudro hi ananto bhāskaro nabhaḥ
medasvinaḥ sarvasamudbhavaśca svarāmayo yo na sa siddhimeti
samprati madhuratiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ śītatvaṃ tathā kaṭvamlalavaṇānāṃ coṣṇatvaṃ tathā kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ cāvṛṣyatvamityādayo rasadvāreṇa dravyāṇāṃ ye guṇā uktāstadapavādam āha teṣāmityādi
eṣā ca asmin śāstre parasyāṃ vaśīkārasaṃjñāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ viśokā nāma siddhir ityucyate
svabhūmijānāṃ rājapaṇyānām ekamukhaṃ vyavahāraṃ sthāpayet parabhūmijānām anekamukham
svapne vināpyarthena kvacideva deśe kiṃcid bhramarārāmastrīpuruṣādikaṃ dṛśyate na sarvataḥ
imāni liṅgāni nareṣu buddhimān vibhāvayetāvahito mumūrṣuṣu
tailaṃ prāvṛṣi varṣānte sarpir anyau tu mādhave
krauñco viṣābhyāśe mādyati glāyati jīvaṃjīvakaḥ mriyate mattakokilaḥ cakorasyākṣiṇī virajyete
paracakrāṭavīhṛtām oghapravyūḍhām araṇyeṣu durbhikṣe vā tyaktāṃ pretabhāvotsṛṣṭāṃ vā parastriyaṃ nistārayitvā yathāsaṃbhāṣitaṃ samupabhuñjīta
tat katham teṣām sāmānyatodṛṣṭādibhyaḥ siddhir iti
tasya paśoryaḥ pratyayānāṃ laukikaśāstrīyavikalpānāṃ tadadhivāsitānāṃ bhinnārthajñānānāṃ vikalpānām apyudbhavaḥ vināśāghrāta utpādaḥ sa parasyāmṛtarasasya cidghanasyānandaprasarasyāpāyo nimajjanam
pāruṣyaṃ rabhasatvaṃ ca pauruṣaṃ teja ucyate
yasya arthasya saṃnidhānāsaṃnidhānābhyāṃ jñānapratibhāsabhedas tat svalakṣaṇam
vajrasaṃhananaṃ vajravat kaṭhinā saṃhatirasya śarīre bhavatītyarthaḥ
na sarvadā na sarvāsu prayogāḥ sāṃprayogikāḥ
dāsasya dāsyā vā duhitaram adāsīṃ prakurvataścaturviṃśatipaṇo daṇḍaḥ śulkāvandhyadānaṃ ca
tṛtīyas tu viṣayānālocito gatyabhāvaḥ sakṛdārabdha eva deśakālasaṃkhyābhiḥ paridṛṣṭo dīrghasūkṣmaḥ
anagnāv iva śuṣkaidho na taj jvalati karhicit
na kenacid īśvarena puruṣena kāryate prabodhyate karaṇam
yaś cādara uktaḥ sa nāntarīyakatvād vedavākyamiśrasamāmnānāt
evaṃ karaṇānāṃ vṛttipaṭutve hetur lāghavaṃ gurutve hi mandāni syur iti sattvasya prakāśātmatvam uktam
śuklākhyaṃ mṛdu kathayanti śuklabhāge saśvetaṃ samamiha vardhate cireṇa
svarūpaṃ punaḥ prakāśātmano buddhisattvasya sāmānyaviśeṣayor ayutasiddhāvayavabhedānugataḥ samūho dravyam indriyam
sarvatra prabhaviṣṇutā vaśitvaṃ sarvāṇy eva bhūtāṇi anurāgitvāt taduktaṃ nātikrāmanti
tathā hi sattvaṃ rajastamasī abhibhūya śāntām ātmano vṛttiṃ labhate
ananyām pṛthivīm bhuṅkte sarva bhūta hite rataḥ
abdhātuṃ dehasthaṃ kupitaḥ pavano yadā viśoṣayati
nirūṣmaṇo jaṭhariṇaḥ śvasano na sa jīvati
pramāṇavaśādastitvaṃ nāstitvaṃ vā nirdhāryate sarveṣāṃ ca pramāṇānāṃ pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇaṃ gariṣṭham ityasatyarthe kathamiyaṃ buddhirbhavati pratyakṣamiti
api ca keṣāṃcin mantrāṇām aśakya evārtho veditum
tulāmānāntaram arghavarṇāntaraṃ vā dharakasya māyakasya vā paṇamūlyād aṣṭabhāgaṃ hastadoṣeṇācarato dviśato daṇḍaḥ
viṣayavatī vā pravṛttir utpannā manasaḥ sthitinibandhinī
athāpi na nanu ityetābhyāṃ samprayujyate anupṛṣṭe
pakvāśayam adhiṣṭhāya hatvā saṃjñāṃ ca mārutaḥ
caturthaṃ rūpaṃ vyavasāyātmakāḥ prakāśakriyāsthitiśīlā guṇā yeṣām indriyāṇi sāhaṃkārāṇi pariṇāmaḥ
prākṛtena ca bandhena tathā vaikārikeṇa ca
dravyavanacchidāṃ ca deyam atyayaṃ ca sthāpayed anyatrāpadbhyaḥ
smayakaraṇe kṛtakṛtyam ātmānaṃ manyamāno na samādhāv utsahate
tatra te aṇimādyāḥ samādhyupayogino bhūtajayāt yoginaḥ prādurbhavanti
sattvaṃ laghu prakāśakam ityatra ca sattvādayaḥ krameṇa nirdekṣyante
anyaśāstropapannānāṃ cārthānāmihopanītānām arthavaśāt teṣāṃ tadvidyebhya eva vyākhyānam anuśrotavyaṃ kasmāt na hy ekasmin śāstre śakyaḥ sarvaśāstrāṇām avarodhaḥ kartum
yena kenāpi sarpeṇa saṃbhavaḥ sarva eva ca
evaṃ ca na kenacid anyena vyatiriktena vastunā bādhyate sarvasmin svātmanaḥ svīkṛtatvāt
atuṣṭāṃs tuṣṭihetos tyāgena sāmnā ca prasādayet
sūkṣmāṇāṃ caudakajantūnāṃ sthūlaiḥ samānarūpāṇāmanīkṣaṇaṃ na syāt
pibecca dhūmaṃ nekṣeta vyoma rūpaṃ ca bhāsvaram
kriyāḥ sarvāḥ pittaharyaḥ praśastāstryahāccordhvaṃ kṣīrasarpiśca nasyam
seyaṃ pāpiṣṭhānāṃ mithyādṛṣṭiḥ akarmanimittā śarīrasṛṣṭir akarmanimittaḥ sukhaduḥkhayoga iti
yo rasānna vijānāti na vā jānāti tattvataḥ
tasmān nāyaṃ dṛṣṭānto na pratyakṣaṃ na cānumānaṃ kiṃcid ucyata iti
purastān nāyakaḥ madhye kalatraṃ svāmī ca pārśvayor aśvā bāhūtsāraḥ cakrānteṣu hastinaḥ prasāravṛddhir vā paścāt senāpatir yāyānniviśeta
ākṣepamokṣaiḥ pātavyo dhūmas tu tris tribhis tribhiḥ
tathā copari bhaktasya sarpiḥ pānaṃ praśasyate
yaś ca sādhananirvartanīyaṃ duḥkhaṃ buddhvā tajjihāsuḥ sādhanaparivarjanāya yatate sa ca duḥkhena tyajyate na viparītaḥ

tadyathā sarṣapikā aṣṭhīlikā grathitaṃ kumbhīkā alajī mṛditaṃ saṃmūḍhapiḍakā avamanthaḥ puṣkarikā sparśahāniḥ uttamā śataponakaḥ tvakpākaḥ śoṇitārbudaṃ māṃsārbudaṃ māṃsapākaḥ vidradhiḥ tilakālakaśceti
yo bālairdharmāṇāṃ svabhāvo grāhyagrāhakādiḥ parikalpitastena kalpitenātmanā teṣāṃ nairātmyaṃ na tv anabhilāpyenātmanā yo buddhānāṃ viṣaya iti

kośagṛhavidhānena madhye vāsagṛham gūḍhabhittisaṃcāraṃ mohanagṛhaṃ tanmadhye vā vāsagṛham bhūmigṛhaṃ vāsannacaityakāṣṭhadevatāpidhānadvāram anekasuruṅgāsaṃcāraṃ tasyopari prāsādaṃ gūḍhabhittisopānaṃ suṣirastambhapraveśāpasāraṃ vā vāsagṛhaṃ yantrabaddhatalāvapātaṃ kārayet āpatpratīkārārtham āpadi vā
snehapītā tanur iva klāntā dṛṣṭir hi sīdati
athāpi yājñe daivatena bahavaḥ pradeśā bhavanti
asamavāyāt sāmānyaṃ karma kāryaṃ na vidyate
ye punaḥ sattvādayo nānubhavapatham ārohanti teṣāṃ kutastyam avivekitvaṃ viṣayatvaṃ sāmānyatvam acetanatvaṃ prasavadharmitvaṃ ceti
saindhavaṃ dāru śuṇṭhī ca mātuluṅgaraso ghṛtam
śuddhaṃ tattvaṃ paraṃ vastu yat tat paraśivātmakam
athāpīdam antareṇa mantreṣv arthapratyayo na vidyate
ādityamīkṣate śuddhaṃ candraṃ vā na sa jīvati
parigrahāt svena vā svāmī svāminā vā svaṃ smaryate
anujñātakrayād upari caiṣāṃ svadeśīyānāṃ paṇyānāṃ pañcakaṃ śatam ājīvaṃ sthāpayet paradeśīyānāṃ daśakam
ko bhedaḥ tīvraṃ mandaṃ ciram āśu nānāprakāram ekaprakāram ityevamādir viśeṣaḥ
etatpiṇḍaṃ lohanibhaṃ muṇḍaprabhaṃ sattvaṃ pātayati pūrvasaṃbadhāt ghanasya ityadhyāhāraḥ
bahuvrīhivad bhāvena yo bahuvrīhiḥ tatra mā bhūt
ihaiva vā rasāyanopayogena yathā māṇḍavyo munī rasopayogād vindhyavāsīti
tasya ca pūrvācāryaiḥ saṃjñā kṛtā vaikṛta iti
tyajet snānaṃ śucaṃ krodhaṃ bhṛśaṃ śayyāṃ himaṃ jalam
pravṛttinivṛttī ca pratyagātmani dṛṣṭe paratra liṅgamiti
pūrvādīni vibhāṣā jasi sarvanāmasañjñāni bhavanti vyavasthāyām asaṃjñāyām
gṛhṇīte vānyathā gandhaṃ śānte dīpe ca nīrujaḥ
yasyāśraddheyārtho vaktā na dṛṣṭānumitārthaḥ sa āgamaḥ plavate mūlavaktari tu dṛṣṭānumitārthe nirviplavaḥ syāt
sahe tathā vidārī ca kaṣāyāḥ secane hitāḥ
karṇāsyākṣisrāvakaṇḍvartijāḍyaṃ tandrā hidhmā dhūmapaṃ na spṛśanti
pṛthivī āpaḥ tejo vāyurākāśam iti bhūtāni
kṣaṇena bhūtvā hyupayānti kānicinnacāphalaṃ liṅgamihāsti kiṃcana
kāṣṭhalohamaṇimayaṃ rajjucarmamṛṇmayaṃ sūtravalkaromamayaṃ vā jātyam ityajātyaṃ vikrayādhānaṃ nayato mūlyāṣṭaguṇo daṇḍaḥ
svargopabhogabhāgīyāt karmaṇo manuṣyajātīyācaritāt kutaścin nimittāl labdhaparipākāt kvacid devanikāye jātamātrasyaiva divyadehāntaritā siddhiraṇimādyā bhavatīti
yathā gaganakusumakūrmaromanaraviṣāṇādiṣu pratyakṣam apravartamānam tadabhāvam avagamayatyevam pradhānādiṣvapi
tān vai srāvān netranāḍīmathaike tasyā liṅgaṃ kīrtayiṣye caturdhā
tatraināṃ madāt saṃjñām apratipadyamānāṃ dūṣayitveti samānaṃ pūrveṇa
ātmasthe manasi saśarīrasya sukhaduḥkhābhāvaḥ sa yogaḥ
yaśca paśyaty adṛśyān vai dṛśyān yaśca na paśyati
evaṃ pañca tanmātrāṇi bhūtānām ākāśādīnāṃ prakṛtayo vikṛtayaścāhaṃkārasya
tathā ca yatra tannāsti mahadādyārambhakrame svargāpūrvadevatādau ca teṣām abhāvaḥ prāpta iti
ye tu manyante prītir na duḥkhābhāvād atiricyata evaṃ duḥkham api na prītyabhāvād anyad iti tān praty ātmagrahaṇam
sarpāṇām eva viṇmūtrāt kīṭāḥ syuḥ kīṭasaṃmatāḥ
taṃ manyeta pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca tasmai na druhyet katamaccanāha
yasya mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca grathitaṃ sampravartate
atrāsmin śāstre ādau prathamaṃ grāsapramāṇaniyamaḥ kartuṃ na śakyaḥ
ata āha kāraṇaguṇātmakatvāt kāryasyāvyaktam api siddham
siddhayogī na lipyate karmaṇā pātakena vā
asaty udaye bhāṇḍanirvahaṇena paṇyapratipaṇyānayanena vā lābhaṃ paśyet
kimartham iti cet puruṣārtha eva hetuḥ
ayaṃ sa śiṅkte yena gaur abhīvṛtā mimāti māyuṃ dhvaṃsanāvadhi śritā
atha kebhyaḥ smṛtir utpadyata iti smṛtiḥ khalu
tasmād avidyamāne svabhāve kāryāṇāṃ parabhāvaḥ paratvaṃ bījādīnāṃ nāstīti paravyapadeśābhāvādeva na parata utpāda iti
tasmād vyaktād vyaktasya tadguṇasya cotpatteḥ kṛtam avyaktenādṛṣṭacareṇeti
samāsagrahaṇaṃ kim samāsa eva yo bahuvrīhiḥ tatra vibhāṣā yathā syāt
sthāne deśe ca kāle ca yoga eṣāṃ vidhīyate
padmātpatraṃ śarkarā darbhamikṣuṃ tālaṃ rodhraṃ vetasaṃ padmakaṃ ca
guṇakarmasu ca bhāvān na karma na guṇaḥ
vāśabdaḥ prathamaniḥṣyandoktanimīlanasamādhiprakāraṃ vikalpayan asyāḥ samāpatter durlabhatāṃ dhvanayati
tatra nirvartako heturiti lakṣaṇāt yo hi yasya nirvartako bījabhāvenāvasthitaḥ sa tasya hetupratyayaḥ
tasya cennakhā vītamāṃsaśoṇitāḥ pakvajāmbavavarṇāḥ syuḥ parāsuriti vidyāt
dṛṣṭiś ca naṣṭā vividhaṃ jagacca tamomayaṃ jāyata ekarūpam
mātsyanyāyābhibhūtāḥ prajā manuṃ vaivasvataṃ rājānaṃ cakrire
kāryaḥ phenaḥ sāgarasyāñjanārthe nārīstanye mākṣike cāpi ghṛṣṭaḥ
adasaḥ sambandhī yo makāras tasmāt pare īdūdetaḥ pragṛhyasañjñā bhavanti
snaihikaḥ puṭapākaśca dhūmo nasyaṃ ca tadvidham
pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ pradhānaṃ syād vivāho dharmataḥ sthiteḥ
lājān madhuneti viṣeṇa paryasya devī kāśirājam viṣadigdhena nūpureṇa vairantyam mekhalāmaṇinā sauvīram jālūtham ādarśena veṇyāṃ gūḍhaṃ śastraṃ kṛtvā devī vidūrathaṃ jaghāna
nāsya rūpamagnirdahati na ca vāyuḥ śoṣayati ityādi yojyam
utpādya vā dhārakaṃ prayatnaṃ śarīrān niḥsaraṇaṃ manasaḥ atas tatropapannaṃ dhāraṇam iti
vidyā vinītaḥ rājā hi prajānām vinaye rataḥ
smṛtihetūnām ayaugapadyād yugapad asmaraṇam ity uktam
agniṃ vā niṣprabhaṃ rātrau dṛṣṭvā maraṇamṛcchati
atha prameyavyutpādanāya pravṛttaṃ śāstraṃ kasmāt pramāṇaṃ sāmānyato viśeṣataśca lakṣayatīti
siprāyante ca gātrāṇi liṅgaṃ sadyo mariṣyataḥ
sīm iti parigrahārthīyo vā padapūraṇo vā
mana ekādaśaṃ kimātmakaṃ kiṃsvarūpaṃ ceti tad ucyate
yo vaikṛtāt sāttvikād ahaṃkārād utpadyate tasya kā saṃjñetyāha
tasya cenmanye parimṛśyamāne na spandeyātāṃ parāsuriti vidyāt
tad idam uktam upastambhakaṃ raja iti
strīprakṛtā sakāmā samānā dvādaśapaṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ dadyāt prakartrī dviguṇam
naradevaḥ kupāṇir viddhayā duṣprayuktayā naṭīṃ kāṇāṃ cakāra
sa jīvitaṃ ca martyānāṃ maraṇaṃ cāvabudhyate
mahākuleṣu sāpatnakair bādhyamānā vidviṣṭā duḥkhitāḥ parityaktāśca dṛśyante
veter vā syād gatikarmaṇo vīrayater vā
tamoniyataṃ tu kvacid eva pravartayatīti tamo niyamārtham
taddharmānabhighātaś ca tasya kāyasya ye dharmā rūpādayasteṣāmabhighāto nāśo nāsya kutaścid api bhavati
indriyāṇi buddhyādīni vāgantāni trayodaśa karaṇāni pūrvoktāni
yaccaivānyat pittahṛccāpi sarvaṃ yadvīsarpe paittike vai vidhānam
vyayān anyāṃśca saṃkhyāya sthāpayed argham arghavit
kiṃ pratyayasya cittaṃ smarati āhosvid viṣayasyeti
aśvagandhā ca śṛṅgī ca sārivā sapunarnavā
athāsyāṅgulīrāyacchet tasya cedaṅgulaya āyamyamānā na sphuṭeyuḥ parāsuriti vidyāt
kṛcchrāt kaphena satataṃ kapharuddhakaṇṭho mandaṃ śanair vadati cāpi divā viśeṣaḥ
tvām ajānatīm iva nāyako balād grahīṣyatīti tathā suparigṛhītaṃ syād iti yojayet
yo vā rasānna saṃvetti gatāsuṃ taṃ pracakṣate
bahumukhaṃ vā rājapaṇyaṃ vaidehakāḥ kṛtārghaṃ vikrīṇīran
ayam eva hi sikatābhyastilānāṃ tailotpādakānāṃ bhedo yad eteṣveva tailam astyanāgatāvasthaṃ na sikatāsviti
na hi satkāryapakṣe kāryasyāvyaktatāyā anyasyāṃ śaktāvasti pramāṇam
tatra yat spandanaṃ tat karaṇajālasya sāmānyā vṛttir iti
tasmiṃśca deśe manuṣyāṇāmidamāhārajātamidaṃ vihārajātametāvadbalam evaṃvidhaṃ sattvamevaṃvidhaṃ sātmyamiyaṃ bhaktirime vyādhayo hitamidamahitamidamiti
tasmāt sataḥ karaṇād asti prāg utpatteḥ pradhāne vyaktam
ucyate parameśvaro māyāśaktyā śarīrakaraṇāni bhedamayāni nirmimīte vidyāśaktyā tv ākāśīyavicitravācakaparāmarśaśarīrān mantrān
buddhiṃ nistimitāṃ kṛtvā tat tattvam avaśiṣyate
kālāni bhūtvā māṃsāni śīryante yasya dehinaḥ
lakṣaṇaṃ tu rūpādi yadi na pratiṣidhyate
iyameva mahāsamāpattiḥ sādhakācāryādīnām abhīṣṭaprāptihetuḥ iti ślokadvayenāha

file: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti-0014-Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 10-2376.conllu
chapter: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 10

text_iast: eraṇḍapallave mūle tvaci vājaṃ payaḥ śṛtam
nidānam āhuḥ paryāyaiḥ prāgrūpaṃ yena lakṣyate
śiraḥpīḍane saṃvāhane corvor ātmānaṃ nāyake niyojayati
guror lakṣaṇam etāvad ādimāntyaṃ ca vedayet
yathā kharaścandanabhāravāhī bhārasya vettā na tu candanasya
sthite kaphe srotasi pittatejasaḥ vilāyyamāne bhṛśasaṃpratāpavān
yāni ca yadrūpasamanugatāni tāni tatsvabhāvāvyaktakāraṇāni yathā mṛddhemapiṇḍasamanugatāḥ kuṭamukuṭādayo mṛddhemapiṇḍāvyaktakāraṇā iti kāraṇam astyavyaktaṃ bhedānām iti siddham
śīryante yasya māṃsāni yatra sarvāśca vedanāḥ
sa tu bāhyābhyantarastambhavṛttir deśakālasaṃkhyābhiḥ paridṛṣṭo dīrghasūkṣmaḥ
anyathā kṣīṇā satī nālam ahaṃkāraṃ janayitum iti sthitiḥ
tasmin upanimantraṇe nānena saṅgaḥ kartavyaḥ nāpi smayaḥ
paraśulkāvaruddhāyāṃ hastavadhaḥ catuḥśato vā daṇḍaḥ śulkadānaṃ ca
svam ity etacchabdarūpaṃ jasi vibhāṣā sarvanāmasañjñaṃ bhavati na cej jñātidhanayoḥ sañjñārūpeṇa vartate
senāpatir asatpragraheṇāvakṣiptaḥ sattribhir ekaikam amātyam upajāpayet lobhanīyenārthena rājavināśāya sarveṣām etad rocate kathaṃ vā tava iti
na tu tadaiva bhavati tasya nityatvāt
utpadyāśu vinaśyanti na cirāt sa vinaśyati
anugatarāji samam ujjvalam amalinam avipāṭitaṃ vivardhiṣṇu mṛdusnigdhadarśanam iti nakhaguṇāḥ
tatra kāryasyodgamane hetur dharmo lāghavaṃ gauravapratidvaṃdvi
saṃsthānaṃ vyañjanaṃ liṅgaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ cihnam ākṛtiḥ
vikasat saṃkucat sarvaṃ vedyaṃ yat saṃvidātmakam
purastād abhyāghāte makareṇa yāyāt paścācchakaṭena pārśvayor vajreṇa samantataḥ sarvatobhadreṇa ekāyane sūcyā
saṃtaptaḥ sa hi janayettṛṣṇāṃ dāholbaṇāṃ nṛṇām
punaḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśāt ṣoḍaśāṃśabhāgajāraṇataḥ chedī bhavet kṣurikādibhiḥ chede kṛte pṛthaktvamāpnoti
manuṣyo hi kutaścinnimittād asurabhavanam upasaṃprāptaḥ kamanīyābhir asurakanyābhir upanītaṃ rasāyanam upayujyājarāmaraṇatvam anyāśca siddhīr āsādayati
akṣamāyāṃ striyāḥ karṇanāsāchedanaṃ vadhaṃ jāraśca prāpnuyāt
pratyakṣavirodhas tāvat bhinnam idaṃ sukhaduḥkhaṃ pratyātmavedanīyatvāt pratyakṣaṃ sarvaśarīriṇām
ānandam udgataṃ dhyātvā tallayas tanmanā bhavet
na hy atejasvināśāya taijasāḥ prabhavanti vai
viśoṣite śleṣmaṇi pittatejasā nṛṇāṃ bhavet srotasi karṇagūthakaḥ
ānande mahati prāpte dṛṣṭe vā bāndhave cirāt
ślakṣṇam ākāritā yā tu darśayet sphuṭam uttaram
śirasi kiṃcid ākuñcitāṅgulinā kareṇa vivadantyāḥ phūtkṛtya prahaṇanaṃ tat prasṛtakam
parasparabhāvātmakatve tu parasparāśrayāpatter ekasyāpyasiddher ubhayasiddhir iti bhāvaḥ
tad yathā strī rūpayauvanakulaśīlasampannā svāminaṃ sukhākaroti
pūrvabhaktaṃ hitaṃ sarpiḥ kṣīraṃ vāpyatha bhojane
atha yāñchabdān āryā na kasmiṃścid arthe ācaranti mlecchās tu kasmiṃścit prayuñjate yathā pikanemasatatāmarasādiśabdāḥ
vyaktaṃ ca khalvindriyagrāhyaṃ tatsāmānyāt kāraṇam api vyaktam
sthūlam api ca lābhaṃ prajānām aupaghātikaṃ vārayet
tacca guṇāntaram asaṃvedyatvād adṛṣṭaṃ vipākakālāniyamāc cāvyavasthitam
yaṃ naraṃ sahasā rogo durbalaṃ parimuñcati
kāraṇena hi kāryaṃ viṣṭaṃ na kāryeṇa kāraṇam

file: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti-0014-Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 10-2376.conllu
chapter: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 10

text_iast: dantān khādati yo jāgradasāmnā virudan hasan
iti mitasiddhyabhilāṣiṇo yoginaḥ samāveśābhyāsarasena dehaṃ vidhyato valīpalitādivyādhijayo bhavatītyapi bhaṅgyānena pratipāditam
sarpiḥ peyaṃ traiphalaṃ tailvakaṃ vā peyaṃ vā syāt kevalaṃ yat purāṇam
buddhīndriyāṇi karmendriyāṇyahaṃkāro manaścaitāni svaṃ svam arthaṃ puruṣasya prakāśya buddhau prayacchanti buddhisthaṃ kurvantītyarthaḥ
liṅgavṛddhimicchatāmakramapravṛttānāṃ śūkadoṣanimittā daśa cāṣṭau ca vyādhayo jāyante
saṃprati tayoḥ sādharmyaṃ puruṣasya ca vaidharmyam āha
eteṣāmindriyāṇāmavasthāpañcake pūrvavat saṃyamaṃ kṛtvā indriyajayī bhavati
sambandhād antevāsinā yuktaṃ guruṃ smarati ṛtvijā yājyam iti
sa yady abhivyajyate bahubhir alpaiś coccāryamāṇas tāvān evopalabhyeta
liṅgam avyaktam alpatvād vyādhīnāṃ tad yathāyatham
tulya āsye prayatno yasya varṇasya yena varṇena saha sa samānajātīyaṃ prati savarṇasañjño bhavati
ciram adṛṣṭāpi prakṛtisthaiva saṃsṛjyate kṛtalakṣaṇāṃ tāṃ darśitākārām upakramet
dehādāv ātmamānitvaṃ dvayam apy etad āṇavam
anumeyasya tulyajātīyeṣv anuvṛtto bhinnajātīyebhyo vyāvṛttaḥ saṃbandho yaḥ tadviṣayā sāmānyāvadhāraṇapradhānā vṛttiḥ anumānam
tad evaṃ prathamadvitīyatṛtīyapādaiḥ samādhitatsādhanatadvibhūtayaḥ prādhānyena vyutpāditāḥ
evaṃ taijasenāhaṃkāreṇendriyāṇyekādaśa pañca tanmātrāṇi kṛtāni bhavanti
vidyād upaśayaṃ vyādheḥ sa hi sātmyam iti smṛtaḥ
gulmī ca madhumehī ca rājayakṣmī ca yo naraḥ
dhānyaṣaḍbhāgaṃ paṇyadaśabhāgaṃ hiraṇyaṃ cāsya bhāgadheyaṃ prakalpayāmāsuḥ
ato manyāmahe nūnam asyaikaikena kaścid avayavaḥ kriyate yat pracayād ayaṃ mahān upalabhyate
tasmāt kāraṇe kāryasya sata eva vibhāgāvibhāgābhyām avyaktaṃ kāraṇam astīti
yat tu nigamaniruktavyākaraṇānām arthavatteti tatraiṣām arthavattā bhaviṣyati na yatra mlecchair apy avagataḥ śabdārthaḥ
karṇaśūlaṃ praṇādaśca bādhiryaṃ kṣveḍa eva ca
athāsya keśalomānyāyacchettasya cet keśalomānyāyamyamānāni pralucyeran na cedvedayeyustaṃ parāsuriti vidyāt
hastau pādau ca manye ca tālu caivātiśītalam
kena saṃsvedya yantrayogena saṃsvedaḥ prabalāgnis tasyedaṃ sambandhi yadyantraṃ yasya yo yogastena
kaścid arthaḥ prakṛtir eva kaścid vikṛtir eva kaścit prakṛtivikṛtiḥ kaścid anubhayaḥ
agnisākṣikā hi vivāhā na nivartanta ityācāryasamayaḥ
yas te na druhyet katamaccanāha tasmai mā brūyā nidhipāya brahman
tad asahamānām utthitāṃ dvitīye ahani prakṛtivartinīm abhiyogārthinīṃ vidyāt
anuktasyārthāpatteḥ pakṣahāner upapattir anuktatvād anaikāntikatvāc cārthāpatteḥ
tathā mahadādilakṣaṇenāpi kāryeṇa sukhaduḥkhamoharūpeṇa svakāraṇagatasukhaduḥkhamohātmanā bhavitavyam
muhurhasan muhuḥ kṣveḍan śayyāṃ pādena hanti yaḥ
upāyaḥ kathyate sākṣād upeyaṃ paramaṃ prati
vikṛtyā na sa rogaṃ taṃ vihāyārogyamaśnute
dvyaṅguloccāṃ dṛḍhāṃ kṛtvā yathāsvaṃ siddham āvapet
tasmāt trividhaṃ karaṇaṃ dvāri dvārāṇi śeṣāṇi karaṇānīti vākyaśeṣaḥ
apratigṛhyābhiyogaṃ punar api saṃsṛjyamānāṃ dvidhā bhūtamānasāṃ vidyāt
athavā vyaktāvyakte pakṣīkṛtyānvayābhāvenāvīta eva hetus traiguṇyād iti vaktavyaḥ
kriyā hi dravyam vinayati na adravyam
ratiyoge hi kīlayā gaṇikāṃ citrasenāṃ colarājo jaghāna
tathordhvārohaṇād utkarṣād unnayanād vodāno nābhideśamastakāntargocaras tatrodāne yat spandanaṃ tat sarvendriyāṇāṃ sāmānyā vṛttiḥ
pañcasv eteṣv indriyarūpeṣu yathākramaṃ saṃyamastatra tatra jayaṃ kṛtvā pañcarūpajayād indriyajayaḥ prādurbhavati yoginaḥ
adhanākhyāyām iti kim prabhūtāḥ svā na dīyante prabhūtāḥ svā na bhujyante
dīrghamucchvasya yo hrasvaṃ naro niḥśvasya tāmyati
yadi na jānanti kathaṃ paracittavido bhavanti
adhyavasāyo buddhiriti lakṣaṇam uktaṃ saiva buddhivṛttiḥ
tasmin śuddhe sāttvike pariṇāme kṛtasaṃyamasya yā sattvapuruṣayor utpadyate vivekakhyātiḥ sā anyatākhyātiḥ
na cottamāṃ na cākāmāṃ pūrvāpatyavatīṃ na ca
śarīrāhaṃkāre sati yā manaso bahirvṛttiḥ sā kalpitetyucyate
bhedānāṃ viśeṣāṇāṃ mahadādīnāṃ bhūtāntānāṃ kāraṇaṃ mūlakāraṇam astyavyaktam
vyādhitaṃ viśato rogau durlabhaṃ tasya jīvitam
sarpiḥ siddhaṃ tarpaṇe sekanasye śastaṃ kṣīraṃ siddhameteṣu cājam
anantaraṃ ca prītyupagraheṇa rāgeṇa tadbāndhavān prīṇayed iti
buddhe khalv api pāṭhād arthe tadabhidhānasamartho mantro bhavati
prāyeṇa hi yuvānaḥ samānaśīlavyasanavayasāṃ vayasyānām arthe jīvitam api tyajanti
vyatirekam āha tadviparyayābhāvād avivekyādiviparyaye puruṣe traiguṇyābhāvāt
śuklāḥ sumanaso lājāḥ payaḥ śālyodanaṃ tathā
ata āha dṛṣṭam anumānam āptavacanaṃ ceti
apratipadyamānāyām antaścāriṇīm anyāṃ kulapramadāṃ pūrvasaṃsṛṣṭāṃ prīyamāṇāṃ copagṛhya tayā saha viṣahyam avakāśam enām anyakāryāpadeśenānāyayet
pṛṣṭhataḥ kakṣyāvibhāge strīniveśo garbhavyādhisaṃsthā vṛkṣodakasthānaṃ ca
sakṣīraṃ karkaṭarase siddhaṃ cātra ghṛtaṃ pibet
vitarkā hiṃsādayaḥ kṛtakāritānumoditā lobhakrodhamohapūrvakā mṛdumadhyādhimātrā duḥkhājñānānantaphalā iti pratipakṣabhāvanam
śatāni sapta cāṣṭau ca daśa manthe daśānile
śūyete vā vinā dehāt sa ca māsaṃ na jīvati
evaṃ vijñaptimātrasyāpi vijñaptyantaraparikalpitenātmanā nairātmyapraveśāt vijñaptimātravyavasthāpanayā sarvadharmāṇāṃ nairātmyapraveśo bhavati na tu tadastitvāpavādāt
niṣkrayānurūpāṃ dāsīṃ prakurvato dvādaśapaṇo daṇḍo vastrāvandhyadānaṃ ca
sā cainām aviditā nāma nāyakasya bhūtvā tadguṇair anurañjayet
agastya indrāya havir nirūpya marudbhyaḥ saṃpraditsāṃcakāra
evaṃ hi śāstrāṇi bahūny adhītya cārtheṣu mūḍhāḥ kharavad vahanti
tasmācchabdārthacintāsu na sāvasthā na yā śivaḥ
kṣīṇasya vṛddhasya kṛśasya cāpi cirotthito yaśca sahopajātaḥ
adhimantho bhavet tatra karṇayor nadanaṃ bhramaḥ

file: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti-0013-Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 9-2375.conllu
chapter: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 9
text_iast: sā ceyaṃ rītistridhā bhidyate vaidarbhī gauḍīyā pāñcālī ceti
na hi prathamaśrutāc chabdāt kaścid arthaṃ pratyeti
bhavati khalu yopasargāttṛṣṇā sā śoṣiṇī kaṣṭā
tatra svārthaṃ trirūpāl liṅgād yad anumeye jñānaṃ tad anumānam
śyāvāḥ syuḥ piśitanibhāśca bindavo ye śuktyābhāḥ sitanayane sa śuktisaṃjñaḥ
yaḥ svabhāvaḥ satsv anyeṣu upalambhapratyayeṣu san pratyakṣa eva bhavati sa svabhāvaviśeṣaḥ
kaṇṭhe ghurghurakaṃ kṛtvā sadyo harati jīvitam
kīlām urasi kartarīṃ śirasi viddhāṃ kapolayoḥ saṃdaṃśikāṃ stanayoḥ pārśvayośceti pūrvaiḥ saha prahaṇanam aṣṭavidham iti dākṣiṇātyānām
āha kiṃ parimiteṣvartheṣvānantyaśabdaḥ utāparimiteṣu kiṃ vā parimitāparimiteṣviti
na hi yādṛśamasmadvijñānaṃ vartamānāvyavahitasambaddhārthaviṣayaṃ tādṛśameva bhagavato vijñānam
tathā samāno madhyadeśavartī ya āhārādīnāṃ samaṃ nayanāt samāno vāyus tatra yat spandanaṃ tat sāmānyakaraṇavṛttiḥ
varaṇārtham upagatāṃśca bhadradarśanān pradakṣiṇavācaśca tatsaṃbandhisaṃgatān puruṣān maṅgalaiḥ pratigṛhṇīyuḥ
avākśirā vā jihmā vā yasya vā viśirā bhavet
mātāpitrośca guṇān abhijñatāṃ lubdhatāṃ ca capalatāṃ ca bāndhavānām
sattvam eva laghu prakāśakam iṣṭaṃ sāṃkhyācāryaiḥ
vijñātasya pariṣadā trir abhihitasyāpi apratyuccāraṇam ananubhāṣaṇam
saptārtavaprajātāṃ varaṇād ūrdhvam alabhamānaḥ prakṛtya prākāmī syānna ca pitur avahīnaṃ dadyāt
apraśastanāmadheyāṃ ca guptāṃ dattāṃ ghonāṃ pṛṣatām ṛṣabhāṃ vinatāṃ vikaṭāṃ vimuṇḍāṃ śucidūṣitāṃ sāṃkarikīṃ rākāṃ phalīnīṃ mitrāṃ svanujām varṣakarīṃ ca varjayet
sugṛhītaṃ tadeva jñaṃ śāstraṃ śastraṃ ca rakṣati
pītābhāsaṃ nīlamuṣṇaṃ jalābhaṃ pittāsrāvaḥ saṃsravet sandhimadhyāt
nidrāndhā vā parispṛśyorubhyāṃ bāhubhyām api tiṣṭhati
evaṃ ca daśāṣṭādaśādibhedena bhinne śaive mantrāṇāṃ spandatattvasārataivetyuktaṃ bhavati
dṛṣṭam eva tad yathā vartitaile analavirodhinī atha ca milite sahānalena rūpaprakāśalakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ kurutaḥ yathā ca vātapittaśleṣmāṇaḥ parasparaṃ virodhinaḥ śarīradharaṇalakṣaṇakāryakāriṇaḥ
pītaṃ pītaṃ hi jalaṃ śoṣayatastāvato na yāti śamam
prāyograhaṇena kena vā nidānaviśeṣeṇāsya kupito doṣo doṣasya hyekasyāpi bahavaḥ prakope hetavaḥ
buddhyahaṃkāramanāṃsi svāṃ svāṃ vṛttiṃ parasparākūtahetukām ākūtādarasaṃbhrama iti
kiṃ ca syāt tarptā tarptum ity atra jharojhari savarṇe iti pakārasya takāre lopaḥ syāt
avedano vāpyathavā savedano ghanaṃ sravet pūti ca pūtikarṇakaḥ
śākalyasya grahaṇaṃ vibhāṣārtham iha apy anuvartate
tad eva vyaktatāṃ yātaṃ rūpam ityabhidhīyate
yadāsatkāryaṃ syāt tataḥ kodravebhyaḥ śālayaḥ syuḥ
avyādhito vyādhito vā tadantaṃ tasya jīvitam
sa eva śabdānuvahā yadā sirāḥ kaphānuyāto vyanusṛtya tiṣṭhati
tatra caturthasya samādheḥ prāptasaptavidhaprāntabhūmiprajñasya antyāṃ madhumatīsaṃjñāṃ bhūmiṃ sākṣātkurvataḥ sthānino devā upanimantrayitāro bhavanti divyastrīrasāyanādikam upaḍhaukayanti
yastūṣṇam iva gṛhṇāti śītamuṣṇaṃ ca śītavat
pradīptam iva lokaṃ ca yo vā plutamivāmbhasā
na ca dṛṣṭānāṃ sparśa ityadṛṣṭaliṅgo vāyuḥ
tadevaṃ pratyayebhya utpādavādini pratiṣiddhe kriyāta utpādavādī manyate
vijānāti na cedduḥkhaṃ na sa rogādvimucyate
kāryaṃ hi kāraṇaguṇātmakaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yathā tantvādiguṇātmakaṃ paṭādi
ayaṃ khalu jñāsyati jānāti ajñāsīd iti trikālaviṣayeṇānekena jñānena sambadhyate

file: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti-0015-Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 11-2377.conllu
chapter: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 11
text_iast: viśrabdhaiḥ kriyatāṃ varāhapatibhirmustākṣatiḥ palvale viśrāmaṃ labhatāmidaṃ ca śithilajyābandhamasmaddhanuḥ
vidradhiśca na sidhyanti ye ca syustilakālakāḥ
niṣṭhyūte yasya dṛśyante varṇā bahuvidhāḥ pṛthak
satyām eva vyavasthāyām iyaṃ teṣāṃ sañjñā
na ca bāhyena saṃsargaṃ kaścid ābhyantaro vrajet
yathā sopānatke pāde dvitīyām upānaham aśakyatvān nopādatte
yoṣitstanyaṃ śātakumbhaṃ vighṛṣṭaṃ kṣaudropetaṃ kaiṃśukaṃ cāpi puṣpam
aṃsābhitāpo hikkā ca chardanaṃ śoṇitasya ca
śarīrād bahir yā manasaḥ śarīranairapekṣyeṇa vṛttiḥ sā mahāvidehā nāma vigataśarīrāhaṃkāradārḍhyadvāreṇocyate
sthāṇum śvabhraṃ darīṃ vāpi vegāndho na samīkṣate
eko yaḥ śaśarudhiropamastu binduḥ śuklastho bhavati tamarjunaṃ vadanti
sā tridhā vaidarbhī gauḍīyā pāñcālī ca
kaphena kaṇḍūḥ pracitena karṇayor bhṛśaṃ bhavet srotasi karṇasaṃjñite
susmūrṣayā manaso dhāraṇaṃ praṇidhānaṃ susmūrṣitaliṅgacintanaṃ cārthasmṛtikāraṇam
rasakriyāṃ śarkarākṣaudrayuktāṃ pālindyāṃ vā madhuke vāpi kuryāt
jña iti asya svabhāvaḥ svo dharmaḥ
na tveva kuryād ātmānaṃ devīṃ vā lakṣyam īśvaraḥ
svasthe tu dvyantaraṃ dadyād ā tṛpter iti yojayet
tāmrā tanvī dāhaśūlopapannā raktājjñeyā parvaṇī vṛttaśophā
pratigṛhyaivaṃ nāyakābhiyogān punar dvitīye ahani saṃvāhanāyopagacchati
udāharaṇāpekṣaḥ tathā iti upasaṃhāro na tathā iti vā sādhyasya upanayaḥ
atra vyākhyāne sahārādhakacittena iti pūrvaślokena yojyam
pūrvābhāve tataḥ kāryo yo ya uttara uttaraḥ
kartaryā kuntalaḥ śātakarṇiḥ śātavāhano mahādevīṃ malayavatīm
dhāraṇaśāstrakṛto vā prajñāteṣu vastuṣu smartavyānām upanikṣepo nibandha iti
prakṛtivirūpaṃ sarūpam ca yad uktaṃ tat katham ityucyate
vāstukapraśaste deśe saprākāraparikhādvāram anekakakṣyāparigatam antaḥpuraṃ kārayet

sarvatra tāvad upāyamārge samastetaravṛttipraśamapūrvam ekāgrībhavanti yoginaḥ etāsvatikrodhādyavasthāsu svarasata eva samastāparavṛttikṣayamayīṣu yadi spandatattvaviviktaye satatam udyukto jhaṭity antarmukhībhavanti yoginas tatsamīhitam acireṇaiva labhante
vidyuto vā vinā meghaiḥ paśyan maraṇamṛcchati
te ced brūyur liṅgajñā atra sma iti
lalāṭe mūrdhni bastau vā nīlā yasya prakāśate
bhavati cātrāgamaḥ anyonyamithunāḥ sarve sarve sarvatragāminaḥ
vistīrṇaṃ mṛdu bahalaṃ yakṛtprakāśaṃ śyāvaṃ vā tad adhikamāṃsajārma vidyāt
tulāmānābhyām atiriktābhyāṃ krītvā hīnābhyāṃ vikrīṇānasya ta eva dviguṇā daṇḍāḥ
vṛddhinimittaṃ paśupālyavāṇijyapratigrahasevāḥ kāryā etad arjanaṃ duḥkham
naivam ityapasāro vā brūyād rūpābhigṛhītaḥ parasya dānakāraṇam ātmanaḥ pratigrahakāraṇam upaliṅganaṃ vā dāyakadāpakanibandhakapratigrāhakopadraṣṭṛbhir upaśrotṛbhir vā pratisamānayet
yatra vāsanā nāsti tatra tasyāḥ phalaṃ kalpyata iti kimatra kāraṇam
raktotpanno hanti tadvat trirātrān mithyācārāt paittikaḥ sadya eva

karmābhigrahastu muṣitaveśmanaḥ praveśaniṣkasanam advāreṇa dvārasya saṃdhinā bījena vā vedham uttamāgārasya jālavātāyananīpravedham ārohaṇāvataraṇe ca kuḍyasya vedham upakhananaṃ vā gūḍhadravyanikṣepaṇagrahaṇopāyam upadeśopalabhyam abhyantaracchedotkaraparimardopakaraṇam abhyantarakṛtaṃ vidyāt
yadi nānyaḥ paramāṇubhyaḥ piṇḍa iṣyate na te tasyeti siddhaṃ bhavati
anante vā samāpannaṃ cittam āsanaṃ nirvartayatīti
athavā bhāvānāṃ kāryāṇām aṅkurādīnāṃ bījādiṣu pratyayeṣu satsvavikṛtarūpeṣu nāsti svabhāvo nirhetukatvaprasaṅgāt
karmaṇā manasā vācā yad aślakṣṇaṃ niṣevate
atha tatpūrvakaṃ trividham anumānaṃ pūrvavat śeṣavat sāmānyatodṛṣṭaṃ ca
teṣāmeva śāntoditāvyapadeśyadharmatvena sthitānāṃ yathāvad vivekajñānaṃ sarvajñātṛtvam
ātmanaśca balaṃ jñātvā tathā yuñjīta śāstravit
pāratantryāt paratantrāṇi bhūtendriyamanāṃsi dhāraṇapreraṇavyūhanakriyāsu prayatnavaśāt pravartante caitanye punaḥ svatantrāṇi syur iti
pratipannām abhipretāvakāśavartinīṃ nāyakaḥ śrotriyāgārād agnim ānāyya kuśān āstīrya yathāsmṛti hutvā ca triḥ parikramet
tasmin nitye pratiṣedhe prāpte vibhāṣeyam ārabhyate
anāturo vā rogī vā ṣaḍrātraṃ nātivartate
evaṃ śaṃkare bhāva upaśleṣitavyo nānyatrety arthaḥ
yadi vijñaptimātramevedaṃ paracittavidaḥ kiṃ paracittaṃ jānantyatha na
syuḥ śuktikā cārjunapiṣṭakau ca jālaṃ sirāṇāṃ piḍakāśca yāḥ syuḥ
kiṃ ca syāt aruś cyotati ity atra jharojhari savarṇe iti śakārasya cakāre lopaḥ syāt
eṣveva dṛṣṭānumānāptavacaneṣu sarveṣāṃ pramāṇānāṃ siddhatvād antarbhāvād ityarthaḥ
bhruvorvā yadi vā mūrdhni sīmantāvartakān bahūn
tathāpanayanād apānas tatra yat spandanaṃ tad api sāmānyavṛttir indriyasya
tair dvyaṇukādikrameṇa pṛthivyādilakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ vyaktam ārabhyate pṛthivyādiṣu ca kāraṇaguṇaprakrameṇa rūpādyutpattiḥ
sati vidhiviṣayatve puruṣeśvarayor viṣayādhikārakṛtaṃ viyogaṃ dṛṣṭvā jñānaparidṛṣṭena vidhinādhyayanadhyānādhikṛto viśuddhabhāvaḥ samīpastha ityarthaḥ
punaścatvāriṃśadbhāgapraveśato rasodare iti śeṣaḥ tadā pāyasākāraḥ kvathitadugdhākāro bhavet nibiḍatvāt
ṛcāṃ tvaḥ poṣam āste pupuṣvān gāyatraṃ tvo gāyati śakvarīṣu
tathānyad api deśasātmyāt prayuktam anyatra na prayuñjīt
tasmān mṛdutvaṃ caṇḍatvaṃ yuvatyā balam eva ca
aṣṭamīcandrikādiṣu ca dhātreyikā madanīyam enāṃ pāyayitvā kiṃcid ātmanaḥ kāryam uddiśya nāyakasya viṣahyaṃ deśam ānayet
tatra yāvad uktaṃ syāj juhotīti tāvad evānnakaraṇena juhotīti
tena puruṣo badhyate puruṣo mucyate puruṣaḥ saṃsaratīti vyapadiśyate yena saṃsāritvaṃ na vidyate
virodhyabhūtaṃ bhūtasya bhūtamabhūtasya abhūmabhūtasya bhūtaṃ bhūtasya
vidyānām tu yathāsvam ācārya prāmāṇyāt vinayaḥ niyamaḥ ca
yattaccakṣurādīnāṃ viṣayo nīlapītādikamiṣyate kiṃ tadekaṃ dravyamatha vā tadanekamiti
nidarśanaṃ cedaṃ smṛtihetūnāṃ na parisaṃkhyānam iti
saṃnikṛṣṭaparicārakopabhogyā sā ced ākāritāpi tathaiva syāt sā marmajñayā dūtyā sādhyā
tatraiva ca deśe kadācid dṛśyate na sarvakālamiti siddho vināpyarthena deśakālaniyamaḥ
trairūpyaṃ punar liṅgasya anumeye sattvam eva sapakṣa eva sattvam asapakṣe ca asattvam eva niścitam
niśy eva pitte pavane saṃsarge pittavaty api
śvetaṃ sāndraṃ picchilaṃ saṃsravedyaḥ śleṣmāsrāvo nīrujaḥ sa pradiṣṭaḥ

file: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti-0009-Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 5-2366.conllu
chapter: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 5
text_iast: na iha katakaṃ payasa iva paṅkasya prasādanāya bhavatīti
savarṇapradeśāḥ akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ ity evamādayaḥ
rajaso mithunaṃ sattvaṃ sattvasya mithunaṃ rajaḥ
pittaṃ matamāgneyaṃ kupitaṃ cet tāpayaty apāṃ dhātum
tathā hi mahattattvam ahaṃkārasya prakṛtir vikṛtiśca mūlaprakṛteḥ
tad anena sukhādīnām ātmaguṇatvam parābhimatam apākṛtam
pālāśaṃ syācchoṇitaṃ cāñjanārthe śallakyā vā śarkarākṣaudrayuktam

file: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti-0010-Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 6-2367.conllu
chapter: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 6

text_iast: yadi cedrasaḥ catuḥṣaṣṭyaṃśān pramāṇato grāsaṃ grasati hi niścitaṃ tadā daṇḍaṃ dhārayet vastrānna kṣaratītyarthaḥ

tasmād etad vṛttikṣayapadaṃ saṃcetya jhaṭiti kūrmāṅgasaṃkocayuktyā krodhasaṃśayavṛttīḥ praśamayya mahāvikāsavyāptiyuktyā vā praharṣadhāvanavṛttīr visphāryābhimukhībhūtanijaspandaśaktivimarśavatā yoginā bhayam
sakṣāraṃ vā ghṛtam pītvā vamet piṣṭaistu nāvanam
vṛddhiguṇau svasaṃjñayā śiṣyamāṇau ikaḥ eva sthāne veditavyau
tasmāddhetuvan nigadasyāpi stutir eva kāryam iti
na caināḥ kulyāḥ paśyeyuḥ anyatra garbhavyādhisaṃsthābhyaḥ
apaprasūtā yukte ca nasye bastau virecane
jāgrat paśyati yaḥ pretān rakṣāṃsi vividhāni ca
daivacintakarūpaśca śakunanimittagrahalagnabalalakṣaṇadarśanena nāyakasya bhaviṣyantam arthasaṃyogaṃ kalyāṇam anuvarṇayet
tadbāndhavāśca yathā kulasyādhaṃ pariharanto daṇḍabhayācca tasmā evaināṃ dadyustathā yojayet
sopakramaṃ nirupakramaṃ ca karma tatsaṃyamād aparāntajñānam ariṣṭebhyo vā
na ca ghaṭakapālayoḥ yutāśrayasamavāyaḥ ghaṭasya teṣveva samavetatvāt
pidhāya chidram ekaikaṃ dhūmaṃ nāsikayā pibet
yatra kāmayate śrotuṃ vā mantuṃ vā tatra tadeva śṛṇoti manute veti
pravṛttaraticakrāṇāṃ na sthānam asthānaṃ vā vidyata iti suvarṇanābhaḥ
aparasmin paraṃ yugapad ayugapacciraṃ kṣipramiti kālaliṅgāni
prakāśo nāma bhāvaprakāśyam na tu pradīpavat
kathaṃ punaridaṃ pratyetavyamanenābhiprāyeṇa bhagavatā rūpādyāyatanāstitvam uktaṃ na punaḥ santyeva tāni yāni rūpādivijñaptīnāṃ pratyekaṃ viṣayībhavantīti
yairvindati purā bhāvaiḥ sametaiḥ paramāṃ ratim
kāruśilpināṃ karmaguṇāpakarṣam ājīvaṃ vikrayakrayopaghātaṃ vā sambhūya samutthāpayatāṃ sahasraṃ daṇḍaḥ

ityupapāditadṛśā vimṛśya ekatra sraṣṭari śaṃkarātmani svabhāve sarvam āropayet nimīlanonmīlanadaśayos tadabhedena jānīyāt pūrvāparakoṭyavaṣṭambhadārḍhyān madhyabhūmim api cidrasāśyānatārūpatayaiva paśyed ityarthaḥ
anubhayam āha na prakṛtir na vikṛtiḥ puruṣa iti
sa rogaḥ śaṅkhako nāmnā trirātrāddhanti jīvitam
yadā tu nāḍīṣu vimārgamāgataḥ sa eva śabdābhivahāsu tiṣṭhati
guṇavṛddhī svasaṃjñayā vidhīyete tatra ikaḥ iti etadupasthitaṃ draṣṭavyam
bhinnaṃ purīṣaṃ tṛṣṇā ca sadyo jahyāt sa jīvitam
sṛṣṭiḥ mūtraśukraśoṇitarūpā ambujaṃ lavaṇaṃ saindhavaṃ kamalam iti mandāḥ
yathā kaścit prakṛtiṃ vetti tasyāḥ saguṇatvanirguṇatvaṃ ca
apratigṛhyābhiyogaṃ saviśeṣam alaṃkṛtā ca punar dṛśyeta tathaiva tam abhigacchecca vivikte balād grahaṇīyāṃ vidyāt
bahirgrāmasya prakṛtāyāṃ mithyābhiśaṃsane ca dviguṇo daṇḍaḥ
ekaṃ śāstram adhīyāno na vidyāc chāstraniścayam
yathā hi pañcamīṃ dhārām āsthāya turagaḥ pathi
nanu ca parasparavirodhaśīlā guṇāḥ sundopasundavat parasparaṃ dhvaṃsanta ityeva yuktaṃ prāgevaiṣām ekakriyākartṛteti
nāsmin ramaṇaṃ sthānam alpam apy astīti vā
tenaiva vidhinā pūrvapidhānena tārapatraṃ rūpyadalaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ śyāmalaprabhaṃ jāyate
iti sthityā satatasamāviṣṭo mahāyogī jīvann eva prāṇādimān api vijñānāgninirdagdhāśeṣabandhano dehapāte tu śiva eva jīvaṃścedṛṅmukta eva na tu kathaṃcid api baddhaḥ
jāyate hṛdi śūlaṃ ca taṃ bhiṣak parivarjayet
punaḥ viṃśatyā viṃśadbhāgajāraṇena avipluṣo bhaved āsanānna calati
antareṇa gudaṃ gacchan nābhiṃ ca sahasānilaḥ
yutasiddhir dvayor anyatarasya vā pṛthaggatimattvam sā ca nityayoḥ yutāśrayasamavetatvaṃ cānityayoḥ yathā ghaṭapaṭayoḥ tvagindriyapārthivaśarīrayośca
śacīr madanta uta dakṣiṇābhir nej jihmāyantyo narakaṃ patāma
yathā caite buddhyādayaḥ pradhānasya liṅgaṃ tathopariṣṭād vakṣyati
sa karṇaviṭko dravatāṃ yadā gato vilāyito ghrāṇamukhaṃ prapadyate
mameti kiṃcin na mameti kiṃcit bhautaṃ saṃghaṃ bahudhā mā lapethāḥ
ā pakṣmāgrād athonmeṣaṃ śanakais tasya kurvataḥ
kārye udakādyavayavini samavāyikāraṇarūpe rūpādaya ārabhyante pākajāstu jalādyaṇuṣu naiva santi virodhiguṇāntarābhāvāt
ṛtvijo vṛṇīte vṛtā yajanti devayajanam adhyavasyantīti
iha loke yo yenārthī sa tadupādānagrahaṇaṃ karoti
tena ca pratyayodbhavenāyam asvatantratām eti tadvaśaḥ sampadyate
apare punar asyānyato viśiṣṭena kanyālābhena kanyāmātaram unmādayeyuḥ
yaḥ śvāsakāsavidhirādita eva coktastaṃ cāpyaśeṣamavatārayituṃ yateta
sa vāte snehanaḥ śleṣmasahite lekhano hitaḥ
nābhiṃ mūtraṃ bastiśīrṣaṃ purīṣaṃ cāpi mārutaḥ
prakarmaṇy akumāryāś catuṣpañcāśatpaṇo daṇḍaḥ śulkavyayakarmaṇī ca pratidadyāt
tadviśeṣān mṛdutīvrasaṃvegasyāsannas tato madhyatīvrasaṃvegasyāsannataras tasmād adhimātratīvrasaṃvegasyādhimātropāyasyāsannatamaḥ samādhilābhaḥ samādhiphalaṃ ceti
tatra savyahastāni pratyagraśikharāṇi dvitriśikharāṇi caṇḍavegayor nakhāni syuḥ
pratiṣedhaṃ sadoṣamabhyupetya pratiṣedhavipratiṣedhe samāno doṣaprasaṅgo matānujñā
vaṃkṣaṇaṃ ca gudaṃ cobhe gṛhītvā māruto balī
tviṣir ity apy asya dīptināma bhavati
bhaikṣyam pātrāgatam māṃsam aduṣyaṃ lavaṇena vā
puṣpavastrayoḥ sati saṃnikarṣe gandhāntarāprādurbhāvo vastre gandhābhāvaliṅgam
prāpya sādhyam aprāpya vā hetoḥ prāptyāviśiṣṭatvād aprāptyāsādhakatvācca prāptyaprāptisamau
tathā ca tatkāraṇaṃ sukhaduḥkhamohātmakaṃ pradhānam avyaktaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati
prasahya kanyām apaharato dviśataḥ sasuvarṇām uttamaḥ
aprāptipūrvā prāptiḥ saṃyogastena saha vartata iti sāvayavam
āśugati manaḥ tasya bahiḥśarīrātmapradeśena jñānasaṃskṛtena sannikarṣaḥ pratyāgatasya ca prayatnotpādanam ubhayaṃ yujyata iti
rogāṃsteṣāṃ cikitsāṃ ca sa kimarthaṃ na budhyate
nanu ca grāhakāhambhāvātmani kṣobhe kṣīṇe nistaraṅgajaladhiprakhyam aspandameva tattvaṃ prasaktam ityāśaṅkāṃ śamayati
pākaḥ sandhau saṃsravedyaśca pūyaṃ pūyāsrāvo naikarūpaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ
yāścānyā api samānajātīyāḥ kanyāḥ śakuntalādyāḥ svabuddhyā bhartāraṃ prāpya samprayuktā modante sma tāścāsyā nidarśayet
śrutāt hi prajñā upajāyate prajñāyāḥ yogaḥ yogāt ātmavat tā iti vidyānām sāmarthyam
uditeṣu bhinnārtheṣu pratyayeṣu cidbhūmiḥ sthitāpy aparāmṛśyamānatvād asthiteva lakṣyate tata evam uktam
diggrahaṇe punaḥ kriyamāṇe jñāyate digupadiṣṭasamāse vibhāṣā anyatra pratiṣedhaḥ iti
vi sīm ataḥ suruco vena āvaḥ

tasmāt kāraṇāt puruṣo na badhyate nāpi mucyate nāpi saṃsarati yasmāt kāraṇāt prakṛtir eva nānāśrayā daivamānuṣatiryagyonyāśrayā buddhyahaṃkāratanmātrendriyabhūtasvarūpeṇa badhyate mucyate saṃsarati ceti
hrasvāni karmasahiṣṇūni vikalpayojanāsu ca svecchāpātīni dākṣiṇātyānām
yathāvidhiś caririti yāḥ kriyāḥ atrādhikṛtasyāninditaṃ karma bhavatītyāha bhagavān
api vā sīmetyetad anarthakam upabandham ādadīta pañcamīkarmāṇam
rogaḥ pāpmā jvaro vyādhir vikāro duḥkham āmayaḥ
purastād alaṅkārabhūmir mantrabhūmir upasthānaṃ kumārādhyakṣasthānaṃ ca
evam ahaṃkāratattvaṃ tanmātrāṇām indriyāṇāṃ ca prakṛtir vikṛtiśca mahataḥ
madhukaṃ rajanīṃ pathyāṃ devadāruṃ ca peṣayet
pratyakṣāpratyakṣāṇām apratyakṣatvāt saṃyogasya pañcātmakaṃ na vidyate
pṛthivy āpas tejo vāyur ākāśaṃ kālo dig ātmā mana iti dravyāṇi
apāṃ saṅghāto vilayanaṃ ca tejasaḥ saṃyogāt
adhimanthe bhaven netraṃ syande tu kaphasaṃbhave
evam ete pañca vāyavaḥ sāmānyakaraṇavṛttiriti vyākhyātās trayodaśavidhasyāpi karaṇasāmānyā vṛttir ityarthaḥ
vāyuḥ śarīre vicaran sadyo muṣṇāti jīvitam
havirbhir eke svar itaḥ sacante sunvanta eke savaneṣu somān
viṣāṇī kakudmān prāntevāladhiḥ sāsnāvāniti gotve dṛṣṭaṃ liṅgam
śuśrūṣā śravaṇa grahaṇa dhāraṇa vijñāna ūha apoha tattva abhiniviṣṭa buddhim vidyā vinayati na itaram
yāni vaidyaḥ pariharedyeṣu karma na sidhyati
śukaḥ sārikā bhṛṅgarājo vā sarpaviṣaśaṅkāyāṃ krośati
cūrṇaṃ kuryādañjanārthe raso vā stanyopeto dhātakīsyandanābhyām
puruṣārthaśūnyānāṃ guṇānāṃ pratiprasavaḥ kaivalyaṃ svarūpapratiṣṭhā vā citiśaktir iti
kāryakāraṇayoḥ paraspareṇa saṃyogavibhāgau na vidyete yathā ghaṭakapālayoḥ yutasiddhyabhāvāt
rātrau sūryaṃ jvalantaṃ vā divā vā candravarcasam
yadi hi hetvādiṣu parabhūteṣu pratyayeṣu samasteṣu vyasteṣu vyastasamasteṣu hetupratyayasāmagryā anyatra vā kvacid bhāvānāṃ kāryāṇāmutpādātpūrvaṃ sattvaṃ syāt syāttebhya utpādaḥ
tasmin dravyaṃ karma guṇa iti saṃśayaḥ
yadā priye parikṣīṇaṃ tadā tadbhairavaṃ vapuḥ
iha mā bhūt dyauḥ panthāḥ saḥ imam iti
evaṃ ca mantrāṇāmudayapralayakoṭivyāpi pravṛttāv api bhittibhūtamiti abhihitam
na caiteṣu nimitteṣu yugapat saṃvedanāni bhavantīti yugapad asmaraṇam iti
dravyatvaṃ guṇatvaṃ karmatvaṃ ca sāmānyāni viśeṣāś ca
kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati dvitīyayā ṣaṣṭhī prādurbhāvyate
lalāṭe dṛśyate yasya ṣaṇmāsānna sa jīvati
adhigatam apy adhyayanam aprabhāṣitam arthataḥ kharasya candanabhāra iva kevalaṃ pariśramakaraṃ bhavati

file: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti-0004-Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Prathama adhyāyaḥ, 5.1-2339.conllu
chapter: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Prathama adhyāyaḥ, 5.1

text_iast: svapneṣvapi na dṛśyante te bhāvāste ca vibhramāḥ
purāṇam itivṛttam ākhyāyikā udāharaṇam dharmaśāstram arthaśāstram ca iti itihāsaḥ
asaṃkhyātā sahasrāṇi ye rudrā adhi bhūmyām
pratyakṣaprāmāṇyād dṛṣṭo hi rūpādiguṇayuktebhyo mṛtprabhṛtibhyas tathābhūtasya dravyasyotpādaḥ tena cādṛṣṭasyānumānam iti
arvāgbhāgasya ca grahaṇaṃ parabhāgasya cāgrahaṇaṃ yugapan na syāt
tathā ca vedavit paṅktimātmavit punate dvijaḥ
rajaḥ pravartakatvāt sarvatra laghu sattvaṃ pravartayed yadi tamasā guruṇā niyamyeta
amvārthāḥ śabdā vāraṇārthā mokṣaṇārthāścālam arthāste te cārthayogāt
evaṃ ca dehāvasthitasyāpi sarvadā glānyabhāva eva parayogino vibhūtiḥ
yat tu śrutir iti naitad arthavādatvāt
taiḥ suniyamitair hanudeśe stanayor adhare vā laghukaraṇam anudgatalekhaṃ sparśamātrajananād romāñcakaram ante saṃnipātavardhamānaśabdam ācchuritakam
upadekṣyata iti yathā paya ityādibhiḥ sambadhyate
athāpy asyaiko raśmiś candramasaṃ prati dīpyate tad etenopekṣitavyam
tāni sarvāṇi lakṣyante na tu sarvāṇi mānavam
nanu karaṇānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ ca tat udayādau tulye kimiti karaṇāni na sarvajñādirūpāṇi
nodanādādyamiṣoḥ karma karmakāritācca saṃskārāduttaraṃ tathottaram uttaraṃ ca
ata eva na hetumattvaṃ tattvāntarasya hetor abhāvāt
tāteti kiṃcittanayeti kiṃcit ambeti kiṃciddayiteti kiṃcit
āturā saṃvāhikā caikena hastena saṃvāhayantī dvitīyena bāhunā sparśam āvedayati śleṣayati ca
kasminnayaṃ deśe jātaḥ saṃvṛddho vyādhito vā
pradīpādāv advipravṛttatvaṃ dṛṣṭam dvir vidyunniḥsṛteti saṃkhyābhāvaḥ sampratipattirjvālādau
kṛtvāpāṅge tato dvāraṃ snehaṃ pātre nigālayet
śṛṇoti śabdān vividhāṃstadā naraḥ praṇādamenaṃ kathayanti cāmayam
urasaśca viśuṣkatvād yo naro na sa jīvati
kṛśasya vaṃkṣaṇau gṛhṇan sadyo muṣṇāti jīvitam
tarpaṇaṃ puṭapākaṃ ca nasyānarhe na yojayet
digupadiṣṭe samāse bahuvrīhau vibhāṣā sarvādīni sarvanāmasañjñāni bhavanti
dhūpyeta vāk kṣayakṛte kṣayamāpnuyācca vāgeṣa cāpi hatavāk parivarjanīyaḥ
rūparasagandhasparśāḥ saṃkhyāḥ parimāṇāni pṛthaktvaṃ saṃyogavibhāgau paratvāparatve buddhayaḥ sukhaduḥkhe icchādveṣau prayatnaś ca guṇāḥ
hṛdayaṃ ca gudaṃ cobhe gṛhītvā māruto balī
srotaḥsu te svaravaheṣu gatāḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ hanyuḥ svaraṃ bhavati cāpi hi ṣaḍvidhaḥ saḥ
atha mukta eva svabhāvāt sa sarvagataśca kathaṃ saṃsarati
kasmānna sarvaṃ prāptaṃ paśyatyañjanaṃ śalākāṃ vā
asyāmeva phalabhūtāyāṃ vivekakhyātau pūrvoktasaṃyamavyatiriktam upāyāntaram āha
na cākṛtyā śabdasya saṃbandhaḥ śakyate kartum
siddhiṃ cānuttamāṃ loke prāpnoti vidhinā paṭhan
diggrahaṇaṃ kim na bahuvrīhau iti pratiṣedhaṃ vakṣyati tatra na jñāyate kva vibhāṣā kva pratiṣedhaḥ iti
anenedamāha yāvadiyaṃ bhinnavedyaprathā tāvad baddha eva yadā tūktopadeśayuktyā sarvam ātmamayam evāvicalapratipattyā pratipadyate tadā jīvanmukta iti
kiṃ kṛtvā tenaiva jāraṇabījavaśena yattasya balābalaṃ nyūnādhikyaṃ tat jñātvetyabhiprāyaḥ
pariṇāmatāpasaṃskāraduḥkhaguṇavṛttirodhāc ca duḥkham eva sarvaṃ vivekinaḥ
peyaṃ pātuṃ na śaknoti kaṇṭhasya ca mukhasya ca
vardhante dāruṇā rogāḥ śīghraṃ śīghraṃ sa hanyate
tasyām api viśokāyāṃ siddhau yadā vairāgyam utpadyate yoginas tadā tasmād doṣāṇāṃ rāgādīnāṃ yad bījam avidyā tasyāḥ kṣaye nirmūlane kaivalyam ātyantikī duḥkhanivṛttiḥ
dakṣiṇottarapūrvāṇām iti dvandve ceti nityaṃ pratiṣedho bhavati
balaṃ ca hīyate śīghraṃ tṛṣṇā cātipravardhate
nāṣṭikaścet tad eva pratisaṃdadhyād yasya pūrvo dīrghaśca paribhogaḥ śucir vā deśas tasya dravyam iti vidyāt
pariṣeke hitaṃ cātra payaḥ śītaṃ sasaindhavam
yataḥ prāṇo nāma vāyurmukhanāsikāntargocaras tasya yat spandanaṃ karma tat trayodaśavidhasyāpi sāmānyā vṛttiḥ
etān spṛśyān bahūn bhāvān yaḥ spṛśannavabudhyate
ātmano vā bhūmiṃ prāptaḥ sarvadeyaviśuddhaṃ vyavahareta
na hi tasyaiva tadidānīṃ grahaṇaṃ cāgrahaṇaṃ ca yuktam
tenaiva yasya paśvākhyā bandhaśaktir na vidyate
śaktitaḥ pravṛttiḥ kāraṇakāryavibhāgāvibhāgau ca mahata eva paramāvyaktatvaṃ sādhayiṣyata iti kṛtaṃ tataḥ pareṇāvyakteneti
tatra hiṃkārādīnām aniyamenābhyāsena vikalpena ca tatkālam eva prayogaḥ
tataḥ tasyāṃ kṛtāt saṃyamāt prakāśāvaraṇakṣayaḥ sāttvikasya cittasya yaḥ prakāśas tasya yadāvaraṇaṃ kleśakarmādi tasya kṣayaḥ pravilayo bhavati
ūrvoḥ stanapṛṣṭhe ca pravāsaṃ gacchataḥ smāraṇīyakaṃ saṃhatāścatasrastisro vā lekhāḥ
deśapravṛttisātmyād vā brāhmaprājāpatyārṣadaivānām anyatamena vivāhena śāstrataḥ pariṇayet
ānantyaṃ punate vidvān nābhātvaṃ yo na paśyati

rasopadeśena rasaguṇakathanadvāreṇa dravyāṇāṃ yaḥ śītoṣṇādiguṇasaṃgrahaḥ kṛtaḥ sa vīryataḥ pākataścāviparītānāṃ teṣāṃ vakṣyamāṇakṣīrādidravyāṇāmeva nirdeṣṭuṃ śakyaḥ na tu rasaviparītavīryavipākānām ityarthaḥ

file: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti-0013-Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 9-2375.conllu
chapter: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 9

text_iast: kavoṣṇaṃ daśamūlāmbu jīrṇāṃ vā vāruṇīṃ pibet
na hy asya prāg abhivyañjanāt sadbhāve kiṃcana pramāṇam asti
dikṣu daśasu bāhyendriyabhūmiṣu carantyo dikcaryaḥ suprabuddhasyādvayaprathāsārāḥ anyeṣāṃ dvayaprathāhetavaḥ
taccaturvidham apahastakaṃ prasṛtakaṃ muṣṭiḥ samatalakam iti
viṃśadbhāgāt triṃśadbhāgasya jāraṇato jalaukākāro bhavet rasa ityadhyāhāraḥ
pakvaḥ śophaḥ sandhijaḥ saṃsravedyaḥ sāndraṃ pūyaṃ pūti pūyālasaḥ saḥ
snānādiṣu niyujyamānā varayitāraḥ sarvaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā na tadaharevābhyupagaccheyuḥ
tad yad ābhir vṛtram aśakaddhantuṃ tacchakvarīṇāṃ śakvarītvam
yac coktaṃ satyavācām etāni vacanānīti tan na
sambhūyakraye caiṣām avikrīte nānyaṃ sambhūyakrayaṃ dadyāt
tāni yadā akuśalebhyo vyāvartayitvā kāmataḥ kuśale yojitāni hataviṣadarvīkaravad avasthitāni bhavanti tadā devanityo jitendriya ityarthaḥ
bhaktiḥ śīlaṃ smṛtistyāgo buddhir balam ahetukam

file: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti-0010-Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 6-2367.conllu
chapter: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 6

text_iast: rāgād yasyāṃ striyāṃ rakto bhavati tām abhīkṣṇaṃ smarati
aviśeṣābhihite arthe vaktur abhiprāyāt arthāntarakalpanā vākchalam
sarpir majjā vasā tailaṃ sneheṣu pravaraṃ matam
liṅgaṃ punaḥ saṃyogi samavāyyekārthasamavāyi virodhi ceti
viriktaśīrṣasya ca śītasevinaḥ karoti hi kṣveḍamatīva karṇayoḥ
evaṃ mantramantreśvarādirūpā śuddhābhimatā sṛṣṭiḥ śivasvabhāveti pratipādyādhunā aśuddhābhimatāpi sā māyādirūpā śivasvarūpaiva iti upapādayan śrīmataśāstrādirahasyadṛṣṭim api upakṣipati
gośabda uccarite sarvagavīṣu yugapat pratyayo bhavati
etair mardanamūrchanapātaiḥ saṃskāraviśeṣaṃ kṛtvā mandavīryatvāt kadarthito bhavati
bhavet prapākaḥ khalu pittakopato vikothavikledakaraśca karṇayoḥ
idaṃ tūdāharaṇaikadeśamātraṃ tenāparāṇy apyevaṃjātīyāny udāhartavyānītyāha evamādīnītyādi
vāmadevāya namo jyeṣṭhāya namo rudrāya namaḥ
na ca sāmānyalakṣaṇam antareṇa śakyaṃ viśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ kartum iti pramāṇasāmānyaṃ tāvallakṣayati
parivrājikā labdhaviśvāsāntaḥpure kṛtasatkārā mahāmātram ekaikam upajapet rājamahiṣī tvāṃ kāmayate kṛtasamāgamopāyā mahān arthaśca te bhaviṣyati iti
tadajñānaṃ pradarśayiṣyamāṇasvarūpeṇonmeṣarūpeṇa cedviluptaṃ nikṛttaṃ tadāsau glānirajñānātmano hetorabhāvāt kutaḥ syānna bhaved ityarthaḥ
sarvadā jāgarāsvapnasuṣuptasaṃvidādimadhyāntapadeṣu prabuddhas tiṣṭhet unmīlitaspandatattvāvaṣṭambhadivyadṛṣṭiḥ suprabuddhatām eva bhajeta
pūrvāhṇe pūrvarātre ca śleṣmā dvandvaṃ tu saṃkarāt
nūnaṃ sā te prati varaṃ jaritre duhīyad indra dakṣiṇā maghonī
āha kāni punastāni vidyāliṅgāni yair guptair vidyā guptā bhavati
tat trividham vākchalaṃ sāmānyacchalam upacāracchalaṃ ca iti
evakāraḥ pratyekaṃ bhinnakramaḥ sambadhyate sattvam eva raja eva tama eveti
brahmā tvo vadati jātavidyāṃ yajñasya mātrāṃ vimimīta u tvaḥ
kālakūṭavatsanābhahālāhalameṣaśṛṅgamustākuṣṭhamahāviṣavellitakagaurārdrabālakamārkaṭahaimavatakāliṅgakadāradakāṅkolasārakoṣṭrakādīni viṣāṇi sarpāḥ kīṭāśca ta eva kumbhagatāḥ viṣavargaḥ
yo vā gandhānna jānāti gatāsuṃ taṃ vinirdiśet
na tu kaścideko draṣṭāsti na yāvanmantetyeva viditvā ye pudgalanairātmyadeśanāvineyās te pudgalanairātmyaṃ praviśanti
tārakaṃ sarvaviṣayaṃ sarvathāviṣayam akramaṃ ceti vivekajaṃ jñānam
ye harṣeṣvabhisaktāḥ dūṣyataḥ taskaratvamāpannāḥ te viśeṣeṇa tu śaṃkarād dūrasthā bhavanti
śukle yat piśitam upaiti vṛddhimetat snāyvarmetyabhipaṭhitaṃ kharaṃ prapāṇḍu
jālābhaḥ kaṭhinasiro mahān saraktaḥ saṃtānaḥ smṛta iha jālasaṃjñitastu
śikṣā stotṛbhyo māti dhagbhago no bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
niśyanyathā vātakaphād rogāḥ syuḥ pittato divā
pacet pradīptair agnyābhaṃ pakvaṃ niṣpīḍya tadrasam
yasmāt kṣayānte trailokyaṃ śaṃkare yāti saṃkṣayam
tisro vidhā asya pramāṇasāmānyasyeti trividhaṃ na nyūnaṃ nāpyadhikam ityarthaḥ
tasya prathamasamāgame pravāsapratyāgamane pravāsagamane kruddhaprasannāyāṃ mattāyāṃ ca prayogaḥ
ikārasādṛśyaṃ ca yakārasyopalabhyate tenāpi tayoḥ prakṛtivikārabhāvo lakṣyate
pūrva parāvaradakṣiṇottarāparādhara ityeṣāṃ gaṇe pāṭhāt pūrveṇa nityāyāṃ sarvanāmasañjñāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ jasi vibhāṣā ārabhyate
gatvā sandhīnaśrumārgeṇa doṣāḥ kuryuḥ srāvān rugvihīnān kanīnāt
viśvasya kāryakalāpasya sā mūlaṃ na tvasyā mūlāntaram astyanavasthāprasaṅgāt
yoṣitstanye sthāpitaṃ yaṣṭikāhvaṃ rodhraṃ drākṣāṃ śarkarāmutpalaṃ ca
icchādveṣaprayatnasukhaduḥkhajñānāny ātmano liṅgam ityataḥprabhṛti yathoktaṃ saṃgṛhyate tena bhūtendriyamanasāṃ caitanyapratiṣedhaḥ
kāsaḥ śvāsaḥ pīnaso visvaratvaṃ pūtir gandhaḥ pāṇḍutā keśadoṣaḥ
tataḥ param arghaṃ vardhayatāṃ kraye vikraye vā bhāvayatāṃ paṇaśate pañcapaṇād dviśato daṇḍaḥ
yathāmyak sā ta indra ṛṣṭir asma iti
ityevaṃ bhagavatyabhyadhikatvaṃ śeṣeṣu puruṣeṣu nyūnatvaṃ jñātvā yuktaṃ vaktuṃ balapramathanāya namaḥ
svarūpam eṣām uktvā prayojanam āha prakāśapravṛttiniyamārthāḥ
na tu rājapratāpena pramuktāṃ svajanena vā
kiṃ punasteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ cakṣurādiviṣayatvaṃ nīlāditvaṃ ca
avayavanam avayavo miśraṇaṃ saṃyoga iti yāvat
pañcamaṃ rūpaṃ guṇeṣu yad anugataṃ puruṣārthavattvam iti
savarṇām aprāptaphalāṃ prakurvato hastavadhaḥ catuḥśato vā daṇḍaḥ
dīrghāṇi hastaśobhīnyāloke ca yoṣitāṃ cittagrāhīṇi gauḍānāṃ nakhāni syuḥ
na hi cidghanāṃ bhūmim anupraviṣṭasya dvaṃdvābhibhavaḥ kaścit prāṇādibhuva eva tadāśrayatvāttasyāś ceha cidbhūmau nimagnatvāt
yasya śūnāni vartmāni na samāyānti śuṣyataḥ
evaṃ puruṣāntaram tām avindat saiva mohayati
prakṛtir evātmānaṃ badhnāti mocayati ca yanna sūkṣmaśarīraṃ tanmātrakaṃ trividhakaraṇopetaṃ tat trividhena bandhena badhyate
buddhyā vivecanāttu bhāvānāṃ yāthātmyānupalabdhistantvapakarṣaṇe paṭasadbhāvānupalabdhivat tadanupalabdhiḥ
ata evāvadhārayati pratyayo nāsti pañcama iti
gṛṇāty upadiśaty arthaṃ tadvīryaṃ cety ato guruḥ
tacca sīdaty apaḥ prāpya na sa jīvitumarhati
tad eva ca pratyakṣaṃ jñānaṃ pramāṇaphalam
taccen niveditam āsādyeta rūpābhigṛhītam āgamaṃ pṛcchet kutaste labdham iti
śallakī kuṅkumaṃ māṣā yavāḥ kundurukas tilāḥ
snehaḥ phalānāṃ sārāṇāṃ medo majjā vasā ghṛtam
yā sthitiś cinmayāhaṃtāviśrāntyātmā ca yo layaḥ
rasācchatasahasralakṣavedhī bhavet sa yatnāt anayā pūrvoktakriyayā sidhyati
na vā tān sarvaśo vidyāttaṃ vidyādvigatāyuṣam
ṛtor duṣṭāt purovātād grahāveśād viṣād garāt
yathā dvyekayor dvivacanaikavacana ityatra dvitvaikatvayor iti
gacchaṃs tiṣṭhan śayāno vā jāgrac caiva svapaṃstathā
karoti doṣaiśca yathāsvamāvṛtaḥ sa karṇaśūlaḥ kathito durācaraḥ
vicchinnasya cānekasya hastyaśvādikasyānekatra vṛttirna syādyatraiva hyekaṃ tatraivāparamiti kathaṃ tayorviccheda iṣyate
dravyāśrayī ityādinā dravyakarmabhyāṃ vaidharmyaṃ kathitam ityarthaḥ

chapter: Commentary on the Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti zu Kāvyālaṃkāravṛtti, 1, Dvitīya adhyāyaḥ, 3

text_iast: samyak jñāna pūrvakā sarva puruṣa artha siddhiḥ iti tat vyutpādyate
dhātvekadeśo dhātuḥ tasya lopo yasmin ārdhadhātuke tad ārdhadhātukaṃ dhātulopaṃ tatra ye guṇavṛddhī prāpnutaḥ te na bhavataḥ
paṇyādhyakṣaḥ sthalajalajānāṃ nānāvidhānāṃ paṇyānāṃ sthalapathavāripathopayātānāṃ sāraphalgvarghāntaraṃ priyāpriyatāṃ ca vidyāt tathā vikṣepasaṃkṣepakrayavikrayaprayogakālān
revatī śuṣkanāmā yā sā te devī prasīdatu
tasmāt taijasād ubhayam utpadyata ubhayam ityekādaśo gaṇastanmātraḥ pañcakaḥ
paṇyādhiṣṭhātāraḥ paṇyamūlyam ekamukhaṃ kāṣṭhadroṇyām ekacchidrāpidhānāyāṃ nidadhyuḥ
kṣīre daśaguṇe tailaṃ nāvanaṃ saniśaiḥ pacet
tat kim sarveṣvatīndriyeṣu sāmānyatodṛṣṭam eva pravartate
asti cedaṃ yatnam antareṇa cetanānāṃ sukhaduḥkhavyavasthānaṃ tenāpi cetanaguṇāntaravyavasthākṛtena bhavitavyam ity anumānam
jihmā vā pariśuṣkā vā nāsikā na sa jīvati
drākṣāṃ kṣaudraṃ candanaṃ yaṣṭikāhvaṃ yoṣitkṣīraṃ rātryanante ca piṣṭvā
yad yat sukhaduḥkhamohātmakaṃ tat tad avivekyādiyogi yathedam anubhūyamānaṃ vyaktam iti sphuṭatvād anvayo noktaḥ
yasyāturasya lakṣyante trīn pakṣānna sa jīvati
svapakṣalakṣaṇāpekṣopapattyupasaṃhāre hetunirdeśe parapakṣadoṣābhyupagamāt samāno doṣa iti
na bibharti śiro grīvā na pṛṣṭhaṃ bhāramātmanaḥ
tena trīṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti u iti v iti ūṃ iti
punastasmin yantre dravati caśabdāt rasendrastatpatraṃ jarati tārakṛṣṇīti
jñātipratiṣedhaḥ iti kim dhūmāyanta iva aśliṣṭāḥ prajvalanti iva saṃhatāḥ
pittānilau pravṛddhau saumyān dhātūṃś ca śoṣayataḥ
atrocyate naiva hi bhāvānāṃ parabhūtebhyaḥ pratyayebhya utpattiriti
tāḥ punar niroddhavyā bahutve sati cittasya
ubhe manye same yasya sadyo muṣṇāti jīvitam
yaḥ khalu cetanāvān sādhananirvartanīyaṃ sukhaṃ buddhvā tad īpsan sādhanāvāptaye prayatate sa sukhena yujyate na viparītaḥ
